In order to capture this phenomenology, we formulate a comprehensive theoretical framework for $(k,n)$-core percolation models on hypergraphs, where each node of a hyperedge is an anchor with probability $θ$, and a hyperedge fails if an anchor node fails. Hypergraph $(k,n)$-core percolation problems can be classified as first-neighbor and second-neighbor problems, indicating that in the pruning process the connectivity is ensured only by the state of the first neighbors or the second neighbors, respectively. We derive self-consistency equations for first-neighbor and second-neighbor (node- and hyperedge-based) pruning processes, and obtain the size of the giant $(k,n)$-core. We obtain the phase diagram, including continuous and discontinuous transitions, and confirm our theory on random hypergraphs using numerical simulations. The results show how the heterogeneity of the nodes' functional roles and the extended range of the interactions affect the robustness of higher-order networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟）。判断依据：关键词为“theoretical framework”“self-consistency equations”“numerical simulations”。；研究对象：超图（hypergraph）上的 $(k,n)$-核渗流（$(k,n)$-core percolation）问题，特别关注带有“锚点”（anchor nodes）的超图，即节点在超边中具有不同功能角色的高阶网络。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在超图中引入锚点（以概率 $θ$ 标记）后，$(k,n)$-核渗流可分类为第一近邻与第二近邻两类剪枝过程；理论推导与数值模拟表明，系统相图包含连续与非连续相变，且节点的功能异质性与相互作用范围显著影响高阶网络的鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在超图中引入锚点（以概率 $θ$ 标记）后，$(k,n)$-核渗流可分类为第一近邻与第二近邻两类剪枝过程；理论推导与数值模拟表明，系统相图包含连续与非连续相变，且节点的功能异质性与相互作用范围显著影响高阶网络的鲁棒性。；创新点：首次将节点功能异质性（锚点与非锚点）纳入超图 $(k,n)$-核渗流的统一理论框架，并区分了第一近邻与第二近邻两类剪枝机制，揭示了锚点概率 $θ$ 对相变类型（连续/不连续）的调控作用。摘要未突出说明与既有超图渗流理论的具体差异细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：分别针对第一近邻和第二近邻（节点基与超边基）剪枝过程推导自洽方程，并求解巨 $(k,n)$-核的大小；数值方法：在随机超图上进行数值模拟以验证理论预测。

papers.title: Superextensive learning in quantum reservoirs at the onset of information scrambling
papers.abstract: The idea that information processing is optimised near the boundary between order and chaos has emerged as a recurring principle across neuroscience, complex systems, and machine learning. Here we test this hypothesis in quantum many-body systems, numerically simulating two-dimensional Ising networks of up to $N=20$ spins, operated as quantum reservoirs for time-series forecasting. Using out-of-time-order correlators (OTOCs), we locate the onset of information scrambling as the input strength is swept, separating regimes where information is frozen and scrambled across the whole reservoir state. We show that prediction precision peaks at the onset of scrambling, along with the number of computational-basis states that the reservoir actively populates. We then show that prediction precision grows as a power law $\sim N^α$ in the reservoir size, superextensively $(α>1)$ at the onset of scrambling and only sublinearly $(α<1)$ in either neighbouring regime. Finally, we show that scrambling enhances the nonlinear components of the reservoir memory while reducing its linear capacity. At the onset, the total memory capacity grows superextensively, provided that the necessary ``forgetting'' mechanism is supplied by a collective relaxation channel. These results consolidate the role of information scrambling in learning systems, turning it from an operating point into a scaling law for the performance of quantum reservoirs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“numerically simulating”（数值模拟）二维Ising网络，属于数值计算研究。；研究对象：二维Ising自旋网络（最多N=20个自旋），作为量子储备池（quantum reservoir）用于时间序列预测，重点关注信息扰乱（information scrambling）现象及其对学习性能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 预测精度在信息扰乱起始点（onset of scrambling）达到峰值，且在该点随储备池尺寸呈超扩展（superextensive）幂律增长（α>1），而相邻区域仅呈亚线性增长（α<1）；扰乱同时增强储备池记忆的非线性成分、降低线性容量，总记忆容量在起始点超扩展增长。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：预测精度在信息扰乱起始点（onset of scrambling）达到峰值，且在该点随储备池尺寸呈超扩展（superextensive）幂律增长（α>1），而相邻区域仅呈亚线性增长（α<1）；扰乱同时增强储备池记忆的非线性成分、降低线性容量，总记忆容量在起始点超扩展增长。；创新点：将信息扰乱从“工作点”提升为量子储备池性能的“标度律”（scaling law），首次揭示在扰乱起始点预测精度随系统尺寸呈超扩展增长（α>1），并阐明扰乱对记忆容量线性/非线性成分的差异化影响及集体弛豫通道对“遗忘”机制的必要性。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟二维Ising量子储备池，使用out-of-time-order correlators（OTOCs，时序外关联子）定位信息扰乱起始点；通过扫描输入强度区分信息冻结与扰乱区域；计算预测精度、计算基态布居数、记忆容量（线性与非线性成分）等指标，并分析其随系统尺寸N的标度行为。

papers.title: Generalizing Thermal Transport in High-Contrast Metamaterials through Interfacial Fresnel Reflection
papers.abstract: The rapid growth of generative AI has intensified the need for efficient heat dissipation in large-scale data centers. To control heat flow, thermal metamaterials with layered structures have been widely used, which impart the anisotropic properties of thermal conductivities. However, the conventional effective medium approximation (EMA) often fails to provide accurate predictions in systems with a high thermal conductivity contrast between adjacent layers embedded in a background medium. Here, we generalize the EMA by introducing two corrective coefficients that extend its validity to regimes where the conventional EMA was previously inapplicable, i.e., high-contrast thermal metamaterials with the background medium. Notably, one of these coefficients that we proposed has the same mathematical form as the Fresnel reflection coefficient in optics. This allows us to interpret the "reflection-like" behavior of heat flow as it penetrates adjacent layers with high thermal contrast. Our findings suggest that heat diffusion, traditionally viewed as a purely dissipative process, can be understood intuitively through the framework of ray optics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“generalize the EMA”“introducing two corrective coefficients”“mathematical form”等理论推导与建模关键词，未涉及实验或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：高导热对比度热超构材料（high-contrast thermal metamaterials），具体为嵌入背景介质中的层状结构，研究其热输运行为及有效热导率的预测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入两个修正系数推广了传统有效介质近似（EMA），使其适用于高导热对比度且存在背景介质的体系；其中一个修正系数在数学形式上与光学中的菲涅尔反射系数相同，从而可将热流穿透高对比度层间界面的行为类比为“反射式”光线传播。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入两个修正系数推广了传统有效介质近似（EMA），使其适用于高导热对比度且存在背景介质的体系；其中一个修正系数在数学形式上与光学中的菲涅尔反射系数相同，从而可将热流穿透高对比度层间界面的行为类比为“反射式”光线传播。；创新点：首次将EMA的适用范围扩展到高导热对比度且含背景介质的层状热超构材料，并建立了热扩散与射线光学（ray optics）之间的直观类比，将传统上视为纯耗散过程的热扩散赋予“反射”式图像。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为有效介质近似（EMA）的推广，通过解析推导引入两个修正系数来修正传统EMA在高对比度条件下的失效问题，并借助与光学菲涅尔反射系数的形式类比进行物理诠释。

papers.title: Battery Recycling: Mechanistic Modelling of LiCoO$_2$ Leaching with Coupled Diffusion-Reaction Kinetics and Film Passivation
papers.abstract: We developed a new mechanistic model for lithium and cobalt recovery during acidic-reductive leaching from LiCoO$_2$. The system considers HCl as an acid and H$_2$O$_2$ as a reducing agent. The model tracks conversion of LCO, the particle radius, the acid, H$_2$O$_2$, formation-dissolution dynamics of Co$_3$O$_4$ film, the film thickness, recovery of lithium and cobalt, and moles of O$_2$. We introduced the film passivation effects for reduced recovery in the absence of H$_2$O$_2$. We validated the model against the experimental data of recovered Li and Co reported in literature at three acid concentrations (0.5 M, 1.5 M, and 2.5 M) and four H$_2$O$_2$ concentrations (0%, 0.2%, 0.4%, and 0.6% (v/v)). The model works reasonably well at 0.5 M and 1.5 M HCl for the 0% and 0.6% concentrations of H$_2$O$_2$. At 2.5 M HCl, the model over-predicts the data in the presence of H$_2$O$_2$, while it works well at 0% H$_2$O$_2$. We suggest pathways for further improvements in the model. The comprehensive mechanistic modelling framework for the leaching with a full list of the equations, the parameters, and the variables, reported for the first time, can be extended to other cathode chemistries and acid-reductive leaching systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“developed a new mechanistic model”（开发新机理模型）、“model tracks”（模型追踪）、“validated the model against experimental data”（用实验数据验证模型），属于建模与数值模拟研究。；研究对象：LiCoO₂（钴酸锂，LCO）正极材料在酸性-还原性浸出过程中的锂和钴回收体系，具体涉及HCl（酸）和H₂O₂（还原剂）作用下的浸出反应动力学、Co₃O₄薄膜的生成-溶解动力学及钝化效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了耦合扩散-反应动力学与薄膜钝化效应的LiCoO₂浸出机理模型，能够合理描述不同HCl和H₂O₂浓度下锂和钴的回收率；在无H₂O₂时，Co₃O₄薄膜钝化效应导致回收率降低，模型成功捕捉了这一现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了耦合扩散-反应动力学与薄膜钝化效应的LiCoO₂浸出机理模型，能够合理描述不同HCl和H₂O₂浓度下锂和钴的回收率；在无H₂O₂时，Co₃O₄薄膜钝化效应导致回收率降低，模型成功捕捉了这一现象。；创新点：首次完整报道了包含全部方程、参数和变量的浸出过程综合机理建模框架；引入薄膜钝化效应来解释无H₂O₂条件下回收率降低的机制；该框架可推广至其他正极材料化学体系和酸-还原浸出系统。摘要未明确说明与以往模型相比的具体定量改进。
papers.method_zh: 机理建模与数值模拟：构建了包含LCO转化率、颗粒半径、酸浓度、H₂O₂浓度、Co₃O₄薄膜生成-溶解动力学、薄膜厚度、Li/Co回收率及O₂生成量等多变量的耦合扩散-反应动力学模型，并引入薄膜钝化效应；模型与文献中三个HCl浓度（0.5 M、1.5 M、2.5 M）和四个H₂O₂浓度（0%、0.2%、0.4%、0.6% v/v）下的实验回收数据进行对比验证。

papers.title: The temperature-dependent non-Abelian gauge potential
papers.abstract: This study shows that the usual time evolution operator can act as a U(1) gauge transformation on the initial wavefuntion. When considering the spin freedom in the system, the time evolution operator corresponds to a non-Abelian SU(2) gauge transformation for spin-1/2 particles and a SU(3) gauge transformation for spin-1 particles. If we adopt the adiabatic approximation in the magnetization dynamics of a ferromagnetic system driven by a spin-polarized current, a temperature-dependent non-Abelian thermal gauge potential will appear. We can employ a temperature-dependent Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert (LLG) equation to describe the magnetization dynamics in the semi-classical limit, a linear approximated solution for this equation is given analytically.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：adiabatic approximation、semi-classical limit、analytically given solution。；研究对象：铁磁体系中自旋极化电流驱动的磁化动力学，以及其中出现的与温度相关的非阿贝尔规范势。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在绝热近似下，自旋极化电流驱动的铁磁磁化动力学中会出现一个温度依赖的非阿贝尔热规范势；该动力学可由含温度的Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert（LLG）方程在半经典极限下描述，并给出了该方程的线性近似解析解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在绝热近似下，自旋极化电流驱动的铁磁磁化动力学中会出现一个温度依赖的非阿贝尔热规范势；该动力学可由含温度的Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert（LLG）方程在半经典极限下描述，并给出了该方程的线性近似解析解。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：利用时间演化算子作为U(1)及SU(2)/SU(3)规范变换的框架，结合绝热近似和半经典极限，推导温度依赖的LLG方程并求其线性近似解析解。

papers.title: Oscillator-Based Processing Unit for Formant Recognition
papers.abstract: Oscillatory neural networks have been successfully applied to a number of computing problems, such as associative memories and computationally hard optimization tasks. In this paper, we show how to use oscillators to process time-dependent waveforms with minimal or no preprocessing. Since preprocessing and first-layer processing are often the most power-hungry steps in neural networks, our findings may open new doors to simple and power-efficient edge-AI devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据关键词：“Oscillatory neural networks have been successfully applied”（神经网络模型应用）、“we show how to use oscillators to process”（提出方法/框架），摘要未涉及实验数据或材料制备。；研究对象：基于振荡器（oscillators）的神经形态计算单元，用于处理随时间变化的波形信号（time-dependent waveforms），具体应用场景为元音识别（Formant Recognition）。摘要未明确说明具体材料或物理体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作展示了利用振荡器网络直接处理时变波形信号，且几乎不需要（或仅需极少）预处理步骤，从而有望降低神经网络中预处理和第一层处理的高功耗，为低功耗边缘AI设备提供新途径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作展示了利用振荡器网络直接处理时变波形信号，且几乎不需要（或仅需极少）预处理步骤，从而有望降低神经网络中预处理和第一层处理的高功耗，为低功耗边缘AI设备提供新途径。；创新点：将振荡神经网络从传统的联想记忆和组合优化任务拓展到时变波形（如语音信号）的直接处理，并强调“最小化或零预处理”这一关键优势，针对边缘AI中功耗瓶颈提出解决方案。摘要未突出说明与传统方法的具体性能对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用振荡神经网络（Oscillatory Neural Networks）的计算框架，通过振荡器之间的耦合动力学实现波形信号的处理与识别。摘要未提及具体数值模拟方法或硬件实现细节。

papers.title: What Should a Large Language Model See? Physical Invariants as a Data Representation for PDE Discovery
papers.abstract: Understanding how molecular interactions govern macroscopic behaviour is a central challenge in molecular sciences. However, conventional theory building cannot keep pace with the vast datasets modern experimentation routinely produces. Large language models offer a promising route to automating theory construction, but a spatiotemporal field cannot be directly placed in a prompt. Existing models generally learn about the data only through a score measuring how well each proposal fits it. Here we introduce data interpretation, a stage that measures the field into the quantities a theorist would consult and supplies them to the model as a direct input. On a benchmark of simulated fields, interpretation nearly triples the accuracy of recovered equations relative to showing the raw data, at negligible computational cost and without any training. By allowing a language model to read field data as a theorist does, data interpretation offers a practical route to automated field theory construction that can coevolve with experimentation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据关键词：benchmark of simulated fields、recovered equations、without any training。；研究对象：分子科学中由分子相互作用主导的宏观行为，具体为时空场数据（spatiotemporal field）所描述的物理体系，以及从这些场数据中自动发现偏微分方程（PDE）的问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 引入“数据解读”（data interpretation）阶段，将场数据测量为理论家会查阅的物理不变量并直接输入大语言模型，相比直接展示原始数据，方程恢复准确率几乎提高三倍，且计算成本可忽略、无需训练。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：引入“数据解读”（data interpretation）阶段，将场数据测量为理论家会查阅的物理不变量并直接输入大语言模型，相比直接展示原始数据，方程恢复准确率几乎提高三倍，且计算成本可忽略、无需训练。；创新点：在LLM用于PDE发现中，首次将“数据解读”作为独立阶段，使模型以理论家的方式“阅读”场数据，而非仅通过拟合分数间接学习数据。摘要未突出说明与其他LLM-based PDE发现方法的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 提出一种数据表示与输入管线：先将模拟的时空场数据转化为物理不变量（如场量、梯度、曲率等理论家常用的量），再将这些量以文本形式提供给大语言模型，用于自动发现控制方程。基准测试基于模拟场数据。

papers.title: Anomalous behavior of Wilson fermions in the presence of monopoles
papers.abstract: Three dimensional compact U(1) gauge theory supports a finite density of monopoles at a fixed lattice gauge coupling. After showing evidence for the expected dependence on the lattice coupling of the density of monopoles, we study the low lying spectrum of a two flavors of two-component Wilson fermions as a function of the bare Wilson mass. The Wilson-Dirac operator that realizes the two flavors are hermitian conjugate of each other to restore parity invariance and the commutativity of the two operators expected in the typical continuum limit is not the case in the presence of monopoles for all values of the lattice gauge coupling. This results in an anomalous behavior where we see clear evidence for the presence of very small eigenvalues for a wide range of a particular sign of the bare Wilson mass. These eigenmodes are typically in one-to-one correspondence with the number of monopoles as defined by the gauge field and the spectrum associated with these modes are separated by a gap from the bulk in the asymptotic regime of the lattice gauge coupling. The eigenvalues come in pairs around zero and the eigenvalues of one sign couple to the monopoles while the modes of the opposite sign couple to the anti-monopole implying flavor symmetry breaking.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要涉及格点规范理论的数值研究（固定格点规范耦合、Wilson费米子谱分析），属于格点场论计算。；研究对象：三维紧致U(1)规范理论中的磁单极子与两味两分量Wilson费米子的相互作用，具体关注Wilson-Dirac算符在磁单极背景下的低能谱行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在磁单极存在时，两味Wilson费米子的Wilson-Dirac算符（互为厄米共轭）不再对易，导致反常行为：在裸Wilson质量某一符号的宽范围内出现大量小本征值，这些本征模与磁单极/反磁单极一一对应，且正负本征值分别耦合到磁单极与反磁单极，暗示味对称性破缺。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在磁单极存在时，两味Wilson费米子的Wilson-Dirac算符（互为厄米共轭）不再对易，导致反常行为：在裸Wilson质量某一符号的宽范围内出现大量小本征值，这些本征模与磁单极/反磁单极一一对应，且正负本征值分别耦合到磁单极与反磁单极，暗示味对称性破缺。；创新点：首次揭示磁单极存在下Wilson费米子算符非对易性导致的异常谱行为，并建立本征模与磁单极/反磁单极的明确对应关系，为理解格点费米子在拓扑缺陷背景下的味对称性破缺提供了新证据。
papers.method_zh: 格点规范理论数值模拟：在固定格点规范耦合下测量磁单极密度及其对格点耦合的依赖，然后计算两味两分量Wilson费米子的低能谱，分析本征值分布与磁单极数的对应关系。

papers.title: First-Principles Prediction of Nonlinear Optical Response in $\text{TiO}_2$ for High-Power Dielectric Mirror Applications
papers.abstract: Dielectric multilayer mirrors are essential components in optical experiments using high-power lasers, where titanium dioxide ($\text{TiO}_2$) is widely employed as a high-refractive-index dielectric material. In this study, we investigate the nonlinear optical response of $\text{TiO}_2$ under intense ultrashort laser pulses using real-time first-principles electron-dynamics simulations based on time-dependent density functional theory (TDDFT). We reveal intensity-dependent absorption driven by multiphoton excitation and optically excited free carriers, and simulate the resulting electron--light coupled dynamics in $\text{TiO}_2$ nanofilms using a multiscale Maxwell--TDDFT framework. Direct evaluation of the reflected and transmitted fields shows reduced reflectance at high intensities ($I \sim 10^{13}~\text{W}/\text{cm}^2$), demonstrating a pronounced nonlinear optical response. Furthermore, the optical response properties are compared among various stable and metastable crystalline phases of $\text{TiO}_2$---rutile, anatase, brookite, $\text{TiO}_2$-II, and $\text{TiO}_2$-B---as well as an amorphous supercell model. These results provide microscopic insight into intensity-dependent optical degradation in $\text{TiO}_2$-based dielectric optical components exposed to intense femtosecond laser fields.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“real-time first-principles electron-dynamics simulations”“time-dependent density functional theory (TDDFT)”“multiscale Maxwell–TDDFT framework”，均为第一性原理计算方法。；研究对象：二氧化钛（TiO₂）在强超短激光脉冲下的非线性光学响应，具体包括多光子激发、光激发自由载流子诱导的吸收，以及TiO₂纳米薄膜中的电子-光耦合动力学；同时对比了金红石、锐钛矿、板钛矿、TiO₂-II、TiO₂-B及非晶超胞模型等多种晶相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高强度（I ~ 10¹³ W/cm²）飞秒激光照射下，TiO₂的反射率显著降低，表现出明显的强度依赖非线性光学响应；该响应源于多光子激发和光激发自由载流子引起的吸收，为TiO₂基介质光学元件在高功率激光下的光学退化提供了微观机制解释。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高强度（I ~ 10¹³ W/cm²）飞秒激光照射下，TiO₂的反射率显著降低，表现出明显的强度依赖非线性光学响应；该响应源于多光子激发和光激发自由载流子引起的吸收，为TiO₂基介质光学元件在高功率激光下的光学退化提供了微观机制解释。；创新点：首次利用多尺度Maxwell–TDDFT框架直接模拟TiO₂纳米薄膜在强飞秒激光下的反射/透射场演化，定量揭示高强度下反射率下降的非线性光学机制，并系统比较了多种TiO₂晶相及非晶相的非线性响应差异。
papers.method_zh: 基于含时密度泛函理论（TDDFT）的实时第一性原理电子动力学模拟；采用多尺度Maxwell–TDDFT框架模拟TiO₂纳米薄膜中电子-光耦合动力学；直接计算反射场和透射场以评估反射率变化；对比多种晶相（rutile、anatase、brookite、TiO₂-II、TiO₂-B）及非晶超胞模型的光学响应。

papers.title: Fluctuation-dissipation structure of quantum geometry
papers.abstract: The geometry of quantum states is a fundamental research area with applications ranging from band theory in condensed matter to variational algorithms in quantum information. Due to their relative simplicity, pure states are usually studied, while mixed ones are needed in general, for instance to allow for finite temperatures. The geometry of mixed states, however, is much more challenging, with important aspects yet to be explored. Here, we provide one missing piece by identifying the structure that relates distance measure and curvature for general (mixed or pure) quantum states. This structure is shown to carry the physical meaning of fluctuation-dissipation---by directly relating distance measure with fluctuations and curvature with linear response---and it turns into the corresponding well-known structure for pure states, where it is Kähler, and only then. We thus obtain a general, simple fluctuation-dissipation picture, which, among its consequences, implies that response functions inherently probe the mixed-state quantum geometric tensor. We end by using this picture to give geometric characterizations of generic transport behaviors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中讨论的是量子态几何的数学结构，涉及距离度量、曲率、涨落-耗散关系等理论概念，未提及实验或数值计算手段。；研究对象：一般量子系统（混合态与纯态）的量子几何结构，特别是其与涨落-耗散关系的联系，以及由此对输运行为的几何刻画。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于一般（混合或纯）量子态，距离度量与曲率之间存在一种具有涨落-耗散物理意义的结构：距离度量直接关联涨落，曲率直接关联线性响应；该结构仅在纯态情形下退化为已知的Kähler结构。由此，响应函数本质上探测的是混合态量子几何张量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于一般（混合或纯）量子态，距离度量与曲率之间存在一种具有涨落-耗散物理意义的结构：距离度量直接关联涨落，曲率直接关联线性响应；该结构仅在纯态情形下退化为已知的Kähler结构。由此，响应函数本质上探测的是混合态量子几何张量。；创新点：填补了混合态量子几何中距离度量与曲率之间关系的空白，建立了普适的涨落-耗散图像，并首次指出响应函数天然探测混合态量子几何张量，进而给出一般输运行为的几何表征。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与结构分析。摘要未明确说明具体数学工具（如微分几何、量子度量张量、线性响应理论等），但显然基于量子几何的形式化框架。

papers.title: Mixed-State Symmetry-Protected Topology and Strong-to-Weak Spontaneous Symmetry Breaking in a Superconducting Qubit Array
papers.abstract: We experimentally investigate how symmetry-protected topological order in a one-dimensional cluster state is transformed by measurement and decoherence in a five-qubit superconducting array. We first characterize the state's nonlocal string order and show that controlled dephasing selectively suppresses one symmetry sector while leaving the other robust, consistent with average symmetry-protected topological order. We then measure one sublattice in a tunable basis and show that the remaining qubits are driven between a long-range-entangled GHZ state and a paramagnetic state. When the measurement record is discarded, the conventional long-range correlator vanishes while a nonlinear fidelity correlator remains finite, providing a finite-size signature of strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking. These experiments demonstrate how conditioning, averaging, and decoherence reveal distinct manifestations of order encoded in the same underlying cluster state, and establish a superconducting-circuit setting for probing mixed-state symmetry and topology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“experimentally investigate”“five-qubit superconducting array”“we measure”等实验关键词。；研究对象：一维团簇态（cluster state）中的对称保护拓扑序，在五比特超导量子比特阵列中受测量和退相干作用后的转变行为，涉及混合态对称保护拓扑（average SPT order）与强到弱自发对称破缺（strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验展示了在同一个团簇态中，通过受控退相干可以选择性地抑制一个对称扇区而保持另一个扇区稳定（对应平均对称保护拓扑序）；当丢弃测量记录时，传统长程关联消失而非线性保真度关联仍有限，为强到弱自发对称破缺提供了有限尺寸特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验展示了在同一个团簇态中，通过受控退相干可以选择性地抑制一个对称扇区而保持另一个扇区稳定（对应平均对称保护拓扑序）；当丢弃测量记录时，传统长程关联消失而非线性保真度关联仍有限，为强到弱自发对称破缺提供了有限尺寸特征。；创新点：首次在超导量子比特阵列中实验实现混合态对称保护拓扑序与强到弱自发对称破缺的探测，展示了条件化（conditioning）、平均化（averaging）与退相干在同一底层团簇态上揭示不同序的途径，建立了超导电路平台用于研究混合态对称性与拓扑。
papers.method_zh: 使用五比特超导量子比特阵列，制备一维团簇态；通过受控退相干（controlled dephasing）调控对称扇区；在可调基矢下测量一个子晶格，并对比保留/丢弃测量记录两种情形下的关联函数（传统长程关联与非线性保真度关联）。

papers.title: Polyaniline as a conductive polymer and its role in improving the efficiency and conductivity of perovskite solar cells
papers.abstract: This article investigates the role of polyaniline as a conductive polymer in the active layer of perovskite solar cells. Samples were created by incorporating polyaniline into the transport layers to assess its impact on enhancing efficiency and conductivity. The application of this polymer across various layers of the cell structure led to improved stability and performance. Given its high doping capability, polyaniline was examined in detail, particularly focusing on two types of oxidation doping and its integration into the hole transport layer. Graphene oxide and reduced graphene oxide were chosen as comparative models, and their performance was evaluated against the standard polyaniline configuration. Laboratory results revealed that power conversion efficiency increased by 17.5% with graphene oxide and by 36.8% with reduced graphene oxide. Furthermore, short-circuit current density improved by 9.8% and 23.1%, respectively. These findings are consistent with existing studies in the field and support the validity of the approach.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要提及“Samples were created”“Laboratory results revealed”等实验操作与实测数据。；研究对象：聚苯胺（polyaniline）作为导电聚合物，被掺入钙钛矿太阳能电池的传输层（特别是空穴传输层）中，用于提升电池效率与导电性。同时以氧化石墨烯（GO）和还原氧化石墨烯（rGO）作为对比体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将聚苯胺掺入钙钛矿太阳能电池传输层可改善器件稳定性与性能；以还原氧化石墨烯替代标准聚苯胺配置后，功率转换效率提升36.8%，短路电流密度提升23.1%（氧化石墨烯对应提升17.5%和9.8%）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将聚苯胺掺入钙钛矿太阳能电池传输层可改善器件稳定性与性能；以还原氧化石墨烯替代标准聚苯胺配置后，功率转换效率提升36.8%，短路电流密度提升23.1%（氧化石墨烯对应提升17.5%和9.8%）。；创新点：系统考察了聚苯胺在不同电池层中的掺杂效果，并引入氧化石墨烯与还原氧化石墨烯作为对比，验证了聚苯胺基配置的改进潜力。摘要未突出说明相对于已有研究的独特新意。
papers.method_zh: 实验制备了含聚苯胺的钙钛矿太阳能电池样品，将聚苯胺掺入不同传输层；重点研究了两种氧化掺杂类型，并将其与氧化石墨烯、还原氧化石墨烯作为对比模型进行性能评估。摘要未明确说明具体表征手段（如J-V曲线、SEM、XRD等）。

papers.title: Multi-Species Multi-Reaction Model Parametrization of a Commercial NCA Positive Electrode from Half-Cell Open-Circuit Potential Data
papers.abstract: Physics-based models of lithium-ion batteries require the open-circuit potential (OCP) of each electrode as a function of its lithiation. The multi-species multi-reaction (MSMR) model provides a compact, thermodynamically grounded description of this relationship, representing each insertion reaction by a standard potential, a site fraction and a disorder parameter. Here, we parametrize the MSMR model for nickel-cobalt-aluminum oxide (NCA), a cathode chemistry widespread in automotive cells, using the positive electrode of a commercial silicon-graphite/NCA cell. Cathode material was harvested from a pristine cell and from cells cycle-aged to the end of life under two state-of-charge windows, and its half-cell OCP was measured by slow galvanostatic cycling. Smooth differential-capacity curves were obtained by histogram counting, and the charge and discharge branches were fitted with a constrained, scale-invariant optimization that keeps every reaction anchored to a visible peak. We report the first MSMR parameter set for an NCA cathode and show, through a differential-capacity peak analysis across aging states, that its thermodynamic signature is essentially unchanged by aging. This finding supports the common modeling practice of holding the electrode's intrinsic parameters fixed and ascribing aging to electrode-level capacity and alignment changes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“harvested from a pristine cell”“half-cell OCP was measured by slow galvanostatic cycling”等实验操作。；研究对象：商用NCA（镍钴铝氧化物）正极材料，具体来自商用硅-石墨/NCA电池的正极，研究其嵌锂/脱锂过程中的开路电位（OCP）与多物种多反应（MSMR）模型参数化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次报道了NCA正极的MSMR参数集，并发现该电极的热力学特征（MSMR参数）在循环老化至寿命终点后基本不变，支持将老化归因于电极容量和电极间对齐变化而非内在热力学性质改变的建模惯例。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次报道了NCA正极的MSMR参数集，并发现该电极的热力学特征（MSMR参数）在循环老化至寿命终点后基本不变，支持将老化归因于电极容量和电极间对齐变化而非内在热力学性质改变的建模惯例。；创新点：首次为NCA正极提供完整的MSMR参数集，并通过跨老化状态的微分容量峰分析验证了老化过程中热力学特征的不变性。
papers.method_zh: 从原始电池和两种SOC窗口下循环老化至寿命终点的电池中提取正极材料，通过慢速恒电流循环测量半电池OCP；采用直方图计数获得平滑的微分容量曲线；使用带约束的、尺度不变的优化方法对充放电分支进行拟合，确保每个反应锚定到可见峰。

papers.title: Exact topology of conservative multiplicative cascades: An ultrametric transfer-operator genus
papers.abstract: The multiplicative cascade is a well-known method for generating random fields that are both genuinely non-Gaussian and scale invariant. Its one-point and scaling statistics, namely the multifractal spectra $τ(q)$, $D_q$, and $f(α)$, are known exactly; however, its geometric and topological measures are not. In this work, we show that the topological structures of a conservative (microcanonical) random permutation cascade can be precisely predicted. We compute the digital (cubical) Euler characteristic, or genus, of the level-$j$ excursion set of the two-dimensional cascade in closed form, using a transfer operator on the cascade's $b$-ary tree closed by its ultrametric structure and a conservative without-replacement sibling split. The result requires no Monte Carlo and matches simulated realizations with a maximum residual of $\sim\!10^{-4}$ in the Euler density, a controlled discretization artifact of the atomic measure. We tie the genus scaling analytically to the multifractal spectrum, and show that for a geometric ladder of weights the genus is exactly self-similar under the multifractal-width dial. The construction uses the tree-sum cumulant machinery of Greiner et al. (Phys. Rev. E 58, 554, 1998), specialized to topological functionals; the conservative split carries the microcanonical fingerprint $\mathrm{Cov}(\ln w_a,\ln w_b)/\mathrm{Var}(\ln w)=-1/(n-1)$ that distinguishes it from canonical and lognormal cascades. The cascade is the multiplicative counterpart of the Rayleigh--Lévy flight and a controlled benchmark for the morphology of strongly non-Gaussian fields.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“we show”“we compute”“requires no Monte Carlo”等表述，属于解析理论推导与数值验证结合的理论计算工作。；研究对象：保守（微正则）随机置换乘性级联（conservative random permutation cascade）生成的二维随机场，重点研究其水平集（excursion set）的拓扑结构（欧拉示性数/亏格）及其与多重分形谱的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该级联的二维水平集在第 j 层的数字（立方）欧拉示性数（亏格）可精确闭式求解，且亏格标度行为与多重分形谱解析关联；在几何权重阶梯下，亏格在多重分形宽度调节下严格自相似。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该级联的二维水平集在第 j 层的数字（立方）欧拉示性数（亏格）可精确闭式求解，且亏格标度行为与多重分形谱解析关联；在几何权重阶梯下，亏格在多重分形宽度调节下严格自相似。；创新点：首次精确预测保守乘性级联的拓扑结构（而非仅统计/标度性质），将拓扑亏格与多重分形谱解析联系，并揭示微正则指纹协方差关系 Cov(ln w_a, ln w_b)/Var(ln w) = -1/(n-1) 与正则及对数正态级联的区分。
papers.method_zh: 利用级联 b 叉树上的传递算子（transfer operator），结合超度量（ultrametric）闭合结构和无放回保守分裂；采用 Greiner 等人（Phys. Rev. E 58, 554, 1998）的树和累积量（tree-sum cumulant）机制，专门用于拓扑泛函；通过数值模拟验证解析结果，最大欧拉密度残差约 10⁻⁴（离散化伪影）。

papers.title: Fast generation of spectrally-shaped disorder, on the sphere
papers.abstract: The design of disordered point patterns with desirable properties is an exciting and ongoing research endeavor, with applications ranging from materials to computer science. A successful approach in recent years has been the optimization of point patterns through a loss function that enforces properties in their Fourier-space representation. Yet, these methods have so far strictly been limited to flat Euclidean space, precluding their use in the contexts of coatings of curved surfaces for photonics, or of sampling of curved manifolds for instance. We introduce FaSHIoNPOp, an algorithm that relies on fast non-uniform spherical harmonics transforms, to enforce pair correlations in point patterns on the sphere with an $O(N \log N)$ complexity in $N$ the number of points. Having demonstrated its performance, we showcase applications of FaSHIoNPOp, ranging from the generation of hyperuniform structures on the sphere for sampling and physical applications, to the design of gyromorphs (disordered structures with maximal scattering power at a given frequency) on the sphere. We additionally show that FaSHIoNPOp can be combined to both global constraints like centrosymmetry, with applications to the design of more isotropic $3d$ gyromorphs, and local real-space constraints like pair repulsion. Our work paves the way for optimal sampling and coating design on curved manifolds, with many applications across physics, materials and computer science.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/算法文章。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“algorithm”“optimization”“fast non-uniform spherical harmonics transforms”“O(N log N) complexity”等关键词，属于计算方法与算法设计。；研究对象：球面上的无序点图案（disordered point patterns on the sphere），具体包括超均匀结构（hyperuniform structures）和陀螺形态（gyromorphs，即在特定频率具有最大散射功率的无序结构），以及三维陀螺形态的构建。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一个名为FaSHIoNPOp的算法，利用快速非均匀球谐变换，在球面上以O(N log N)复杂度高效生成具有可控傅里叶空间（即对关联）性质的无序点图案，并展示了其在超均匀结构生成、球面采样及三维陀螺形态设计中的应用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一个名为FaSHIoNPOp的算法，利用快速非均匀球谐变换，在球面上以O(N log N)复杂度高效生成具有可控傅里叶空间（即对关联）性质的无序点图案，并展示了其在超均匀结构生成、球面采样及三维陀螺形态设计中的应用。；创新点：首次将无序点图案的傅里叶空间优化方法从平面欧几里得空间推广到球面（弯曲流形），突破了此前方法仅限于平坦空间的限制，为曲面涂层设计和弯曲流形采样提供了新工具。摘要未明确说明与已有平面方法在具体性能上的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 基于快速非均匀球谐变换（fast non-uniform spherical harmonics transforms）的迭代优化算法，通过损失函数约束点图案在傅里叶空间的表示（即对关联函数），并可与全局约束（如中心对称性）和局域实空间约束（如对排斥）相结合。

papers.title: Accidental accuracy and vertex corrections in $GW$: Exact benchmarks for the extended Hubbard model
papers.abstract: The $GW$ approximation is the standard tool for quasiparticle predictions in materials, yet its regime of validity in correlated systems remains poorly quantified, because \textit{ab initio} vertex corrections are computationally prohibitive. Using exact diagonalization of the half-filled extended Hubbard model on finite rings as a numerically exact reference, we construct the corresponding model-space $GW$ theory on the identical Hilbert space and quantify its error as a function of local ($U$) and non-local ($V$) interaction strength. We find that the vertex correction changes character across the phase diagram: in the weak-coupling regime the effective vertex $Γ_{\rm eff} < 1$, reflecting the suppression of RPA charge fluctuations by exact short-range correlations, whereas in the Mott regime $Γ_{\rm eff}$ grows monotonically (to $\sim 3$ for $N=6$, reflecting the local vertex required to open the Hubbard gap. Vertex corrections in the electron-hole (polarizability) channel are shown to \emph{worsen} the gap error, indicating that the Mott gap resides in the self-energy channel. For $V=0$, static $COHSEX$ is accidentally exact at a single crossover point $U^* \approx 3.5\,t$; finite $V$, through non-local Fock exchange, splits this point into a double-crossover window that collapses toward weak coupling. These results yield quantitative diagnostics for the reliability of $GW$ in correlated materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：使用精确对角化（exact diagonalization）作为数值精确参考，构建模型空间GW理论并进行误差量化，属于强关联电子系统的基准计算方法研究。；研究对象：半填充扩展Hubbard模型（extended Hubbard model）有限环（finite rings），包含局域相互作用U和非局域相互作用V，重点关注Mott绝缘体相与弱耦合电荷涨落区域。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: GW近似的顶点修正（vertex correction）在相图中改变符号特征：弱耦合区有效顶点Γ_eff < 1（抑制RPA电荷涨落），Mott区Γ_eff单调增大至约3（打开Hubbard能隙所需）；电子-空穴（极化率）通道的顶点修正反而恶化能隙误差，表明Mott能隙源于自能通道。此外，静态COHSEX在V=0时于单一交叉点U* ≈ 3.5t处偶然精确，有限V通过非局域Fock交换将该点分裂为双交叉窗口并向弱耦合坍缩。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：GW近似的顶点修正（vertex correction）在相图中改变符号特征：弱耦合区有效顶点Γ_eff < 1（抑制RPA电荷涨落），Mott区Γ_eff单调增大至约3（打开Hubbard能隙所需）；电子-空穴（极化率）通道的顶点修正反而恶化能隙误差，表明Mott能隙源于自能通道。此外，静态COHSEX在V=0时于单一交叉点U* ≈ 3.5t处偶然精确，有限V通过非局域Fock交换将该点分裂为双交叉窗口并向弱耦合坍缩。；创新点：首次在完全相同Hilbert空间上对GW近似进行精确基准测试，明确区分了极化率通道与自能通道中顶点修正的不同作用，并揭示了静态COHSEX在特定参数点“偶然精确”的非平凡交叉行为。
papers.method_zh: 以半填充扩展Hubbard模型有限环的精确对角化作为数值精确参考，在相同Hilbert空间上构建对应的模型空间GW理论，系统比较GW与精确结果以量化误差随U和V的变化；分析有效顶点Γ_eff及COHSEX近似的交叉行为。

papers.title: Predicting THz Generation Capability of Organic Crystals through Data Mining and Crystal Nonlinearity Models
papers.abstract: We report the use of DFT computation and mathematical models to predict the nonlinear dielectric polarization (P^{NL}) and nonlinear susceptibility coefficients (χ^{(2)}_{IJK}) of organic materials based on their crystal structures. We apply this computation approach on single-component crystals, co-crystals and ionic crystals found through data mining the Cambridge Structural Database. We verify these computational results with experimental terahertz (THz) generation efficiencies for known THz generators, demonstrating consistency between the measurements and the computed values. Several mined structures show similar or larger PNL values compared to state-of-the-art THz generation crystals DAST, OH1 and BNA, suggesting great potential for their use in nonlinear optical (NLO) applications. Importantly, we also compared the resulting model of nonlinear optical tensor components with commonly-used simplifications of nonlinearity, showing that the comprehensive approach should be the standard method to evaluate the nonlinear optical properties of single-crystalline materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：摘要明确提到使用DFT计算和数学模型进行预测，并通过数据挖掘晶体结构数据库，属于计算与数据驱动研究。；研究对象：有机晶体材料，包括单组分晶体、共晶和离子晶体，用于太赫兹（THz）产生和非线性光学（NLO）应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过DFT和数学模型计算的非线性介电极化（P^NL）和二阶非线性系数（χ^(2)_IJK）与已知THz产生晶体的实验效率一致；数据挖掘发现若干有机晶体的P^NL值可与DAST、OH1和BNA等先进THz晶体相当或更大，具有NLO应用潜力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过DFT和数学模型计算的非线性介电极化（P^NL）和二阶非线性系数（χ^(2)_IJK）与已知THz产生晶体的实验效率一致；数据挖掘发现若干有机晶体的P^NL值可与DAST、OH1和BNA等先进THz晶体相当或更大，具有NLO应用潜力。；创新点：将数据挖掘与DFT+非线性模型相结合，实现对有机晶体THz产生能力的系统性高通量预测；并指出完整张量模型应取代常用的简化非线性近似作为评估单晶NLO性质的标准方法。
papers.method_zh: DFT计算（具体泛函/基组摘要未明确说明）结合晶体非线性光学数学模型，计算P^NL和χ^(2)_IJK张量；使用剑桥结构数据库（CSD）进行数据挖掘筛选候选晶体；将计算结果与实验THz产生效率进行对比验证。

papers.title: AlV$_2$O$_4$ thin films via in-situ interfacial topotaxy
papers.abstract: Conventional oxide epitaxy approaches face challenges when the oxidation conditions of constituent elements differ significantly. Here we demonstrate that V--O thin films can serve as solid-phase precursors for epitaxial AlV$_2$O$_4$, comprising a pyrochlore V$^{2.5+}$ network coexisting with AlO$_4$ tetrahedra within the spinel structure. The epitaxial AlV$_2$O$_4$/Al$_2$O$_3$ (0001) heterostructures are realized via interfacial topotactic transformation, involving V--O growth at a moderate temperature followed by in-situ ultra-high-temperature post-annealing to drive a reaction with the Al$_2$O$_3$ substrate. Transmission electron microscopy and temperature-dependent X-ray diffraction analyses reveal excellent structural characteristics that closely reproduce the known charge-ordering transition. This study presents a novel approach to realizing epitaxial structures with convoluted oxidation states where thermodynamic and kinetic barriers would otherwise limit synthesizability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到薄膜生长、退火、透射电子显微镜、X射线衍射等实验手段。；研究对象：AlV₂O₄薄膜，具体为尖晶石结构中含有烧绿石V².⁵⁺网络与AlO₄四面体共存的体系，以及其与Al₂O₃(0001)衬底构成的异质结。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过界面拓扑反应，利用V–O薄膜作为固相前驱体，成功在Al₂O₃衬底上外延生长出AlV₂O₄薄膜，且该薄膜具有优异的结构质量，并复现了已知的电荷有序相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过界面拓扑反应，利用V–O薄膜作为固相前驱体，成功在Al₂O₃衬底上外延生长出AlV₂O₄薄膜，且该薄膜具有优异的结构质量，并复现了已知的电荷有序相变。；创新点：提出了一种通过固相前驱体与衬底发生原位界面拓扑反应来制备具有复杂氧化态外延结构的新方法，克服了传统氧化物外延中因各元素氧化条件差异过大而导致的合成困难。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（或类似薄膜沉积）生长V–O薄膜，随后进行原位超高温后退火以驱动与Al₂O₃衬底的拓扑反应；采用透射电子显微镜和变温X射线衍射表征结构及相变行为。

papers.title: Roton Instability in Quantum Droplets with Finite-Range Soft-Core Interaction
papers.abstract: We investigate the emergence of roton instability in self-bound quantum droplets interacting via a finite-range soft-core potential modeled by a Heaviside step interaction. The ground-state properties are obtained by solving the extended Gross-Pitaevskii equation including Lee-Huang-Yang corrections with a nonlocal interaction term. The collective excitation spectrum reveals the formation and progressive softening of a roton minimum as the interaction strength and range increase. When the roton energy approaches zero, the system becomes unstable, signaling the onset of density modulation. The rotonic behavior is further characterized through the static structure factor, which exhibits pronounced peaks at the roton momentum.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“求解扩展Gross-Pitaevskii方程”（theoretical framework）以及“集体激发谱”和“静态结构因子”的计算（computational characterization）。；研究对象：具有有限程软芯相互作用（Heaviside阶梯势）的自束缚量子液滴，具体关注其集体激发谱中的旋子（roton）不稳定性及由此引发的密度调制不稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着相互作用强度和相互作用程增大，量子液滴的集体激发谱中出现旋子极小值并逐渐软化；当旋子能量趋近于零时，系统失稳，标志着密度调制（周期性结构）的开始。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着相互作用强度和相互作用程增大，量子液滴的集体激发谱中出现旋子极小值并逐渐软化；当旋子能量趋近于零时，系统失稳，标志着密度调制（周期性结构）的开始。；创新点：首次在具有有限程软芯相互作用的自束缚量子液滴中系统研究旋子不稳定性的形成与演化，并利用静态结构因子在旋子动量处的显著峰来佐证旋子特征。（摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异）
papers.method_zh: 采用包含Lee-Huang-Yang（LHY）修正和非局域相互作用项的扩展Gross-Pitaevskii方程求解基态性质；通过计算集体激发谱和静态结构因子来表征旋子行为。

papers.title: Kinetic Turnover in the Early-Stage Nucleation of Multi-Shell Condensed Clusters
papers.abstract: Nucleation is a key rate-limiting process in phase transition and phase separation. Recent studies highlight a significant discrepancy between experimentally measured nucleation rates and theoretical predictions, particularly when dynamic structural reordering occurs along multi-step pathways. To bridge this gap, we develop a multi-shell model with a space-time-dependent order-parameter field to describe the reordering-nucleation process, where structural reorganization couples with the early growth of condensed clusters. Through stochastic simulations, we track the time-resolved evolution of heterogeneous structural order inside growing clusters. Path analysis of the first-passage problem in early-stage nucleation demonstrates that shifting the reordering rate alters the nucleation rate by several orders of magnitude. Furthermore, as the coupling strength increases, the relationship between the mean first-passage time and reordering susceptibility shifts from monotonic to non-monotonic, exhibiting a turnover effect. We quantitatively rationalize these behaviors with an effective nucleation barrier that accounts for non-equilibrium properties. Our findings elucidate the mechanisms behind multi-step nucleation and offer a predictive framework for future studies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a multi-shell model”“stochastic simulations”“path analysis”，属于理论建模与数值模拟研究。；研究对象：多壳层凝聚团簇在早期成核阶段的结构重排-成核耦合过程，具体涉及多步成核路径中动态结构有序化与团簇生长的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 结构重排速率的变化可使成核速率改变数个数量级；随着重排与生长耦合强度的增加，平均首通时间与重排敏感性之间的关系从单调变为非单调，出现“翻转效应”（turnover effect），该行为可由包含非平衡特性的有效成核势垒定量解释。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：结构重排速率的变化可使成核速率改变数个数量级；随着重排与生长耦合强度的增加，平均首通时间与重排敏感性之间的关系从单调变为非单调，出现“翻转效应”（turnover effect），该行为可由包含非平衡特性的有效成核势垒定量解释。；创新点：提出了一个能同时描述结构重排与团簇生长的多壳层理论框架，并揭示了耦合强度导致的成核速率非单调翻转效应，为多步成核机制提供了定量预测框架。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: 构建了具有空间-时间依赖序参量场的多壳层模型，用于描述结构重排与团簇早期生长的耦合；采用随机模拟追踪生长团簇内部异质结构序的时间分辨演化；通过首通问题的路径分析研究早期成核动力学。

papers.title: Beyond capillary condensation: Shear-induced bridging transitions in patterned slits
papers.abstract: We study the equilibrium phase behavior of a fluid confined in a slit made from two patterned walls. Shearing the walls frustrates the fluid, due to a competition between capillary condensation and interface delocalization, forcing the formation of bridging phases with different pinning properties. This leads to an unusually rich phase diagram, displaying first-order and continuous phase transitions, depending sensitively on the slit width and shear. Generalized Kelvin equations determine the phase boundaries, while the bridging phases are characterized by large correlation lengths, predictions for which are tested using a microscopic density functional model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“equilibrium phase behavior”“Generalized Kelvin equations”“microscopic density functional model”等理论建模与数值求解关键词。；研究对象：受限在由两个图案化壁面构成的狭缝中的流体，重点研究剪切作用下的毛细凝聚与界面去定域竞争所诱导的桥接相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 剪切壁面会迫使流体形成具有不同钉扎性质的桥接相，产生异常丰富的相图，其中包含一级相变和连续相变；相边界可由广义开尔文方程描述，桥接相具有大关联长度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：剪切壁面会迫使流体形成具有不同钉扎性质的桥接相，产生异常丰富的相图，其中包含一级相变和连续相变；相边界可由广义开尔文方程描述，桥接相具有大关联长度。；创新点：将剪切引入图案化狭缝中的毛细凝聚问题，揭示了毛细凝聚与界面去定域之间的竞争如何导致多种桥接相及丰富相图，并给出了广义开尔文方程的相边界描述。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与微观密度泛函理论（classical density functional theory, DFT）建模。摘要明确提到使用“microscopic density functional model”对预测进行检验，并用广义开尔文方程解析描述相边界。

papers.title: Multiscale Modelling of Ferroelectrics using a Physics-Informed Neural Network Driven by Molecular Dynamics Data: Parameter Identification and Field Reconstruction
papers.abstract: In multiscale modeling of ferroelectrics, combining atomistic simulation with continuum-scale phase-field models (PFM) remains a fundamental challenge. A key difficulty lies in faithfully capturing discrete atomic-level information within a continuum modeling framework, while accurately representing material behavior at the mesoscale. In this paper, a Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) driven by molecular dynamics (MD) data is used. The loss function of the network consists of a supervised term that fits the discrete spatial polarization distributions obtained from MD simulations of systems containing domain walls, and a physics-based term that incorporates the residuals of partial differential equations (PDEs) of steady-state PFM. To ensure stable and balanced training among the different loss components, adaptive gradient normalization (GradNorm) is used to dynamically adjust the task weights. By minimizing the total loss, the model not only reconstructs the polarization field along with the associated strain, stress, and energy landscape at the continuum scale, but also identifies critical physical parameters of the phase-field model, including the characteristic energy density, characteristic length factor, gradient energy anisotropy factor, and Landau polynomial coefficients. By using the PINN-predicted physical parameters in COMSOL Multiphysics to solve the corresponding PDEs within a finite element framework, we demonstrate that these parameters enable accurate reproduction of the ferroelectric domain structure and the associated material response, including stress/strain distributions and energy landscape. This framework provides an effective methodology for establishing multiscale connections between atomistic and continuum descriptions, and holds the potential to infer underlying physical properties directly from polarization distributions for a wide range of materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN)”“molecular dynamics (MD) data”“phase-field models (PFM)”“finite element framework”等计算与建模关键词，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：铁电材料的多尺度建模，具体涉及含畴壁（domain walls）的铁电体系，关注其极化场、应变、应力及能量景观的连续介质描述。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过MD数据驱动的PINN，不仅能在连续尺度上重建铁电体的极化场及伴随的应变、应力和能量分布，还能识别出相场模型的关键物理参数（特征能量密度、特征长度因子、梯度能各向异性因子及Landau多项式系数），且这些参数在有限元求解中能准确复现畴结构与材料响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过MD数据驱动的PINN，不仅能在连续尺度上重建铁电体的极化场及伴随的应变、应力和能量分布，还能识别出相场模型的关键物理参数（特征能量密度、特征长度因子、梯度能各向异性因子及Landau多项式系数），且这些参数在有限元求解中能准确复现畴结构与材料响应。；创新点：提出了一种将原子尺度（MD）信息与连续介质相场模型（PFM）通过PINN框架直接连接的多尺度方法，并实现了从极化分布数据中同时完成参数辨识与场重构，而非仅做正向模拟。摘要未突出说明与传统多尺度方法（如参数拟合或均匀化）相比的具体优势细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用物理信息神经网络（PINN），其损失函数包含两项：一项是监督项，拟合含畴壁体系的MD模拟得到的离散空间极化分布；另一项是物理项，包含稳态相场模型（PFM）偏微分方程的残差。训练中使用自适应梯度归一化（GradNorm）动态调整各损失项的权重。参数验证通过COMSOL Multiphysics的有限元求解完成。

papers.title: Enhanced Superconductivity in Multilayer FeSe Films by Simplified Molecular Beam Epitaxy
papers.abstract: Multi-unit-cell (UC) \b{eta}-FeSe films grown on SrTiO3(100) continue to attract attention because of the significant enhancement in the superconducting transition temperature (Tc) compared to that in bulk FeSe. In prior reports of molecular beam epitaxy (MBE)-grown \b{eta}-FeSe/SrTiO3(100), elaborate growth protocols have been used to achieve enhanced Tc, leading to a general belief that careful pre-treatment of the SrTiO3 substrate and post-growth annealing in ultrahigh vacuum (UHV) are essential. Here, we report a greatly simplified protocol for the MBE growth of superconducting multi-UC \b{eta}-FeSe films on SrTiO3(100), eliminating the need for careful substrate pre-treatment and post-growth UHV annealing while still achieving an enhanced Tc. With appropriate capping, epitaxial films with 14 UC thickness exhibit a zero-resistance transition temperature Tc ~ 20 K in ex situ electrical transport measurements. The MBE optimization process is guided by the growth-parameter dependencies of film morphology and structural properties, as characterized by reflection high-energy electron diffraction, X-ray diffraction, atomic force microscopy, and scanning transmission electron microscopy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了分子束外延（MBE）生长、输运测量、反射高能电子衍射、X射线衍射、原子力显微镜、扫描透射电子显微镜等实验手段。；研究对象：生长在SrTiO₃(100)衬底上的多层（多单胞）β-FeSe薄膜，重点关注其超导转变温度增强现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过大幅简化的分子束外延生长方案，无需精细衬底预处理和超高真空后退火，即可在14个单胞厚的β-FeSe薄膜中实现零电阻转变温度Tc ≈ 20 K的增强超导电性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过大幅简化的分子束外延生长方案，无需精细衬底预处理和超高真空后退火，即可在14个单胞厚的β-FeSe薄膜中实现零电阻转变温度Tc ≈ 20 K的增强超导电性。；创新点：打破了以往认为SrTiO₃衬底精细预处理和生长后超高真空退火是获得增强Tc的必要条件的普遍认知，大幅简化了生长流程，同时仍能实现增强的超导电性。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）薄膜生长；反射高能电子衍射（RHEED）监测生长过程；X射线衍射（XRD）表征结构；原子力显微镜（AFM）表征形貌；扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）表征微观结构；外加保护层后的非原位（ex situ）电输运测量（确定零电阻Tc）。

papers.title: Hierarchical Quantum Transport from Coupled Topological Domain-Wall States in SSH Chains
papers.abstract: We investigate the transport properties of Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) chains containing multiple topological domain walls and show that their interaction generates a hierarchy of emergent spectral structures. Each domain wall contributes a localized state inside the SSH gap, and the hybridization of these states produces minibands whose signatures are directly reflected in the transmission spectra. By combining domain-wall lattices with different domain-wall separations, we construct effective SSH structures within the miniband subspace. The resulting transmission spectra reproduce the characteristic features of conventional SSH chains, including gap formation, finite-size resonances, and the correspondence between transmission spectra and band structure. The construction can be applied recursively, generating successive generations of effective SSH structures. As a consequence, effective SSH spectra repeatedly emerge within progressively narrower energy intervals, producing a self-similar hierarchy of minibands and spectral gaps. To understand the origin of this hierarchy, we develop an effective renormalized description based on successive decimation. The effective parameters exhibit a hierarchy of interlaced singularities whose number increases at each iteration. These singularities partition the energy axis into progressively finer intervals and provide a natural interpretation of the repeated fragmentation of the spectrum. Our results show that topological domain-wall states can act as emergent degrees of freedom from which multiscale transport channels, effective couplings, and hierarchical spectral structures may be engineered. More generally, the framework introduced here establishes a connection between recursive topological constructions, effective Hamiltonians, and the emergence of self-similar spectra in one-dimensional systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据关键词：investigate transport properties、develop an effective renormalized description、decimation（重整化/递推理论分析）。；研究对象：含多个拓扑畴壁的Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）链，具体研究畴壁态之间的耦合及其产生的层级化（hierarchical）输运与谱结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 多个拓扑畴壁态之间的杂化可在SSH能隙内形成微带，且通过递归构造可在越来越窄的能量区间内反复涌现有效SSH谱，形成自相似的微带与谱隙层级结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：多个拓扑畴壁态之间的杂化可在SSH能隙内形成微带，且通过递归构造可在越来越窄的能量区间内反复涌现有效SSH谱，形成自相似的微带与谱隙层级结构。；创新点：提出拓扑畴壁态可作为“涌现自由度”，通过递归构造在微带子空间内生成多代有效SSH结构，从而建立递归拓扑构造、有效哈密顿量与一维系统自相似谱之间的直接联系。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值计算相结合：基于紧束缚SSH模型计算透射谱；利用有效重整化描述（逐次decimation）推导有效参数，分析其奇点层级结构；通过构造不同畴壁间距的畴壁晶格实现微带子空间内的有效SSH模型。

papers.title: Jerky Motion of Active Granular Particles
papers.abstract: Abrupt transitions between rest and motion can render the standard Newtonian description -- based on position, velocity, and acceleration -- incomplete, requiring higher-order derivatives such as the jerk, the third time derivative of position. Here, we show that the interplay between activity and dry friction gives rise to robust jerk-dominated dynamics in self-propelled particles: the particle speed increases quadratically with time under an active force, in contrast to the linear growth expected for conventional Newtonian dynamics. We demonstrate this behavior analytically, numerically, and experimentally using active vibrobots self-propelling on a vertically vibrating plate at low vibration amplitudes, where surface asperities generate dry friction and, thus, give rise to jerky motion when combined with activity. Our results establish dry friction as a simple mechanism for realizing higher-order dynamics in active matter and suggest that jerky dynamics may arise broadly in nonequilibrium systems with frictional contacts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论分析 + 数值模拟 + 实验验证）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“analytically, numerically, and experimentally”。；研究对象：活性颗粒体系中的“急动”（jerk，位置的三阶时间导数）主导动力学，具体体系为在垂直振动板上自推进的活性振动机器人（vibrobots），在低振动幅度下表面粗糙度产生干摩擦。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 活性与干摩擦的相互作用使自推进颗粒呈现急动主导的动力学：在活性力作用下，颗粒速度随时间呈二次方增长（而非牛顿动力学预期的线性增长），表明标准牛顿描述（位置、速度、加速度）在此类体系中不完整。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：活性与干摩擦的相互作用使自推进颗粒呈现急动主导的动力学：在活性力作用下，颗粒速度随时间呈二次方增长（而非牛顿动力学预期的线性增长），表明标准牛顿描述（位置、速度、加速度）在此类体系中不完整。；创新点：首次确立干摩擦作为实现活性物质中高阶动力学（急动动力学）的简单机制，并指出含摩擦接触的非平衡体系中可能广泛存在急动行为。
papers.method_zh: 理论解析推导（基于活性力与干摩擦的动力学方程）；数值模拟；实验采用垂直振动板上的活性振动机器人，在低振动幅度下运行，利用表面粗糙度产生干摩擦。

papers.title: Visualizing flat-band spatial renormalization in rhombohedral graphene superlattices
papers.abstract: Rhombohedral graphene/hBN moiré superlattices exhibit flat-band-driven emergent phases, including superconductivity and the fractional quantum anomalous Hall effect (FQAHE), yet the microscopic role of the moiré potential remains unclear. Here, using scanning tunneling microscopy, we visualize moiré-modulated spatial renormalization of flat bands in rhombohedral pentalayer and tetralayer graphene/hBN superlattices. We observe spatially hierarchical filling, manifested as periodic energy shifts of the flat bands at the moiré scale, leading to spatial reshaping of correlated states in the interacting regime. Remarkably, this modulation vanishes below a ~10 nm moiré period--the same threshold below which the FQAHE is absent. Theoretical modeling attributes this mechanism to atomic-corrugation-induced charge redistribution. Our work provides real-space visualization of moiré-engineered flat-band reconstruction, resolving a key link between moiré periodic potential and emergent topological order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“scanning tunneling microscopy”（扫描隧道显微镜）进行实空间可视化观测。；研究对象：菱方堆垛石墨烯（rhombohedral pentalayer/tetralayer graphene）与hBN形成的莫尔超晶格，以及其中的平带空间重整化现象，关联态的空间重塑，以及平带调制与分数量子反常霍尔效应（FQAHE）缺失之间的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在菱方五层和四层石墨烯/hBN莫尔超晶格中，平带在莫尔尺度上发生周期性能量位移，导致空间分级的填充行为；该空间调制在莫尔周期小于约10 nm时消失，与FQAHE消失的阈值一致，表明莫尔势对平带的重构与拓扑有序的出现直接相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在菱方五层和四层石墨烯/hBN莫尔超晶格中，平带在莫尔尺度上发生周期性能量位移，导致空间分级的填充行为；该空间调制在莫尔周期小于约10 nm时消失，与FQAHE消失的阈值一致，表明莫尔势对平带的重构与拓扑有序的出现直接相关。；创新点：首次在实空间直接可视化莫尔工程导致的平带重构，将莫尔周期势的空间调制与FQAHE的缺失阈值（~10 nm）建立直接联系，揭示了原子级起伏引起的电荷重分布这一微观机制。
papers.method_zh: 扫描隧道显微镜（STM）实空间成像与谱学，结合理论建模（摘要提及“atomic-corrugation-induced charge redistribution”的机制建模，但未指明具体计算方法）。

papers.title: Thermal diffuse scattering in TEM: complex absorptive potentials compared to the frozen phonon model
papers.abstract: In transmission electron microscopy, electrons undergo inelastic scattering primarily through phonon excitations, known as thermal diffuse scattering. To capture the inelastic scattering effects on the elastic scattering components, absorptive effects must be included in the modeling of electron propagation, accounting for the gradual depletion of the elastic channel of the electron beam. Several approaches to modeling this absorption exist. In this paper, we compare the widely used complex absorptive potentials method to the more elaborate frozen phonon model, based on correlated atomic motion and on the Einstein model of atomic motion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算方法对比文章。关键词：compare、modeling、complex absorptive potentials method、frozen phonon model。；研究对象：透射电子显微镜（TEM）中电子与晶体相互作用产生的热漫散射（thermal diffuse scattering），具体关注非弹性散射对弹性散射通道的耗损（吸收效应）的建模方法。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 系统比较了两种模拟热漫散射吸收效应的方法——广泛使用的复数吸收势方法与更精细的冻结声子模型，后者可基于关联原子运动或爱因斯坦模型实现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：系统比较了两种模拟热漫散射吸收效应的方法——广泛使用的复数吸收势方法与更精细的冻结声子模型，后者可基于关联原子运动或爱因斯坦模型实现。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断其新意在于对两种主流吸收建模方法（复数吸收势 vs. 冻结声子模型）在热漫散射描述上的系统对比，并考察了原子运动关联性对结果的影响。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值模拟对比。具体比较了复数吸收势方法（complex absorptive potentials）与冻结声子模型（frozen phonon model），其中冻结声子模型分别采用关联原子运动（correlated atomic motion）和爱因斯坦模型（Einstein model）两种原子运动描述。

papers.title: Exciton fine structure in nanocrystals: effect of cuboidal and spheroidal shapes
papers.abstract: We present the theory of the band-edge exciton fine structure in nanocrystals (NCs) with spheroidal and cuboidal shapes. The effects of the cubic symmetry of the crystal lattice, the cubic shape of the NC, and NC uniaxial anisotropy on the hole energy states and electron-hole exchange interactions are considered non-perturbatively. Symmetry analysis yields an effective Hamiltonian for the exciton fine structure, parameterized by one constant for hole energy splitting and five independent constants for exchange interaction. Numerical calculations reveal that in uniaxially anisotropic zinc-blende NCs, the sign of the hole ground state splitting depends on the material parameters and on the orientation of the anisotropy axis relative to the crystallographic axes. Beyond the conventional bulk cubically-symmetric contribution to the exchange interaction, which originates from Bloch-function symmetry and is typically negligible, in nanocrystals, we identify the contribution arising from the cubic symmetry of the envelope wavefunction. This cubically symmetric envelope-induced short-range exchange is non-negligible in cuboidal NCs and induces a pronounced splitting of the dark exciton states. We further analyze the influence of uniaxial anisotropy of the exchange constants on both the exciton fine structure and the oscillator strength. Special attention is paid to NCs, where the anisotropy of the exchange constants is comparable to a relatively small hole energy anisotropic splitting.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确出现“We present the theory”“Symmetry analysis yields an effective Hamiltonian”“Numerical calculations reveal”等关键词，属于理论建模与数值计算研究。；研究对象：纳米晶体（NCs）中的带边激子精细结构，具体针对椭球形（spheroidal）和立方体形（cuboidal）两种形状的纳米晶，考虑闪锌矿（zinc-blende）晶体结构、晶格立方对称性、纳米晶形状及单轴各向异性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在单轴各向异性的闪锌矿纳米晶中，空穴基态劈裂的符号取决于材料参数及各向异性轴相对于晶轴的方向；此外，在立方体形纳米晶中，由包络波函数立方对称性诱导的短程交换作用不可忽略，会导致暗激子态产生显著劈裂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在单轴各向异性的闪锌矿纳米晶中，空穴基态劈裂的符号取决于材料参数及各向异性轴相对于晶轴的方向；此外，在立方体形纳米晶中，由包络波函数立方对称性诱导的短程交换作用不可忽略，会导致暗激子态产生显著劈裂。；创新点：首次识别出纳米晶中由包络波函数立方对称性（而非传统体材料布洛赫函数对称性）诱导的短程交换作用贡献，该贡献在立方体形纳米晶中不可忽略并导致暗激子态明显劈裂；同时系统分析了交换常数单轴各向异性与较小空穴各向异性劈裂可比拟时的激子行为。
papers.method_zh: 对称性分析构建激子精细结构的有效哈密顿量（含1个空穴能量劈裂常数和5个独立交换作用常数），并结合数值计算对激子精细结构和振子强度进行分析。交换作用与空穴各向异性劈裂均采用非微扰（non-perturbatively）处理。

papers.title: Long-Range Order and Composite Boson Condensation in Lattice Quantum Hall States
papers.abstract: Topological states of matter, such as quantum Hall states, are characterized by the absence of local order parameters. In the continuum, their topological order has been reinterpreted as the condensation of nonlocal composite bosons, but this condensation and the resulting long-range correlations have so far eluded direct confirmation beyond the simplest trial states. Here, we apply tensor-network methods to lattice Hamiltonians hosting quantum Hall states, revealing this exotic order directly in interacting ground states and demonstrating both the long-range correlations and the condensation of composite bosons. These correlations define a nonlocal order parameter that identifies phase transitions between trivial and topological phases, for both bosonic and fermionic models. The corresponding operators are accessible through site-resolved, local measurements on an extensive number of particles, making them directly probable in quantum simulators. Our work opens new avenues for microscopic studies of topological quantum matter beyond the reach of traditional solid-state approaches.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“应用张量网络方法”（tensor-network methods）到格点哈密顿量，属于数值计算方法，且涉及理论概念（复合玻色子凝聚、非局域序参量）。；研究对象：格点量子霍尔态（lattice quantum Hall states），包括玻色型和费米型模型，具体为在格点哈密顿量中承载量子霍尔拓扑序的相互作用基态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在相互作用基态中直接展示了复合玻色子的凝聚及其对应的长程关联，这种非局域关联可作为区分平庸相与拓扑相的序参量，并适用于玻色和费米模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在相互作用基态中直接展示了复合玻色子的凝聚及其对应的长程关联，这种非局域关联可作为区分平庸相与拓扑相的序参量，并适用于玻色和费米模型。；创新点：首次在非简单试探波函数的相互作用基态中直接证实了复合玻色子凝聚和长程关联，将这一原本仅在连续模型中最简试探态中讨论的概念推广到格点模型，并建立了可实验探测的非局域序参量。
papers.method_zh: 张量网络方法（tensor-network methods），用于求解格点哈密顿量的基态并计算非局域关联函数；同时提出通过位点分辨的局域测量（site-resolved local measurements）在量子模拟器上探测相应算符的方案。

papers.title: Ideal Bose-Einstein condensation in the canonical ensemble: exact asymptotic estimates from large deviations
papers.abstract: In this work we present a large-deviations approach to the calculation of the canonical partition function for free bosons. Three-dimensional Bose-Einstein condensation is studied in the fixed-density ensemble as a function of the dimensionless density $\varrho = ρλ_T^3$, with $ρ=N/L^3$ the standard particle density, $λ_T$ the thermal wavelength, $L$ the linear size of the box and $N$ the total number of particles. A large-deviations approach in terms of the dimensionless parameter $\ell=L/λ_T$ allows us to provide exact asymptotic estimates of the canonical partition function both above and below the critical density $\varrho_c$ for Bose-Einstein condensation. We show how this approach allows to explicitly account for finite-size effects and how it fully captures the first-order aspects of the transition, allowing us to explicitate its driving mechanism in terms of the competing probabilities of normal and condensed phases. The proposed large-deviations approach allows then to obtain in all regimes explicit and simple analytical expressions, at the leading order in the large parameter $\ell$, for both the average fraction of particles in the ground state, the condensate fraction $\langle n_0(\varrho) \rangle = \langle N_0(\varrho) \rangle/N$, and for its fluctuations, $σ_0(\varrho) = \sqrt{\langle N_0^2(\varrho)\rangle - \langle N_0(\varrho)\rangle^2}/N$, retrieving for instance the anomalous scaling $σ_0(\varrho)\sim 1/V^{1/3}$ in the condensed regime, $\varrho > \varrho_c$. Our large-deviations asymptotic estimate, by analytically clarifying the mixed-order nature of Bose-Einstein condensation, allows then to reveal the similarity between this transition and other mixed-order transitions, as for instance the localization transition in the Discrete Non-Linear Schrödinger Equation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“large-deviations approach”“exact asymptotic estimates”“analytical expressions”等理论推导关键词，未涉及实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：三维自由玻色气体的理想玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（BEC），具体研究在正则系综、固定密度条件下，凝聚体分数及其涨落随无量纲密度 ϱ = ρλ_T³ 的变化，以及有限尺寸效应和相变的一阶/混合阶特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过大偏差方法，在临界密度上下均获得了正则配分函数的精确渐近估计，并解析地揭示了BEC的混合阶（mixed-order）相变本质，例如在凝聚区（ϱ > ϱ_c）得到反常标度 σ₀(ϱ) ~ 1/V^{1/3}。该方法还表明该相变与离散非线性薛定谔方程中的局域化相变具有相似性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过大偏差方法，在临界密度上下均获得了正则配分函数的精确渐近估计，并解析地揭示了BEC的混合阶（mixed-order）相变本质，例如在凝聚区（ϱ > ϱ_c）得到反常标度 σ₀(ϱ) ~ 1/V^{1/3}。该方法还表明该相变与离散非线性薛定谔方程中的局域化相变具有相似性。；创新点：首次将大偏差框架系统应用于自由玻色子正则配分函数的精确渐近计算，显式纳入有限尺寸效应，并解析阐明BEC的混合阶相变机制（正常相与凝聚相的竞争概率），从而将其与其它混合阶相变（如DNLS局域化）联系起来。摘要未突出说明与以往BEC有限尺寸理论的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用大偏差理论（large-deviations approach），以无量纲参数 ℓ = L/λ_T 为大参数，对自由玻色子的正则配分函数进行渐近分析；在固定密度系综中分别处理临界密度上下区域，并计算基态粒子数平均分数 ⟨n₀(ϱ)⟩ 及其涨落 σ₀(ϱ) 的领先阶解析表达式。

papers.title: Engineering Plasmons in Oxide/Graphene Heterostructures via Interfacial Charge Transfer
papers.abstract: Interfacial charge transfer provides an effective route for tailoring the optical and electronic properties of two-dimensional materials. Here, we investigate infrared surface plasmon polaritons in oxide/graphene heterostructures using scattering-type scanning near-field optical microscopy. Ultrathin oxide overlayers deposited by physical vapor deposition enable systematic engineering of graphene plasmons through interfacial charge redistribution. MoOx strongly enhances the plasmonic response, producing a longer plasmon wavelength, stronger fringe contrast, and reduced damping, whereas a subsequently deposited ZnOx overlayer partially reverses these changes. Energy-dependent nano-infrared imaging combined with quantitative modeling reveals an increased graphene carrier density and the resulting modification of the plasmon dispersion. Thickness-dependent measurements show a rapid increase in charge-transfer doping at sub-nanometer MoOx thicknesses, followed by a weaker long-range contribution at larger overlayer thicknesses. Electrostatic gating further modulates the carrier density and produces a nonlinear response consistent with gate-dependent interfacial charge redistribution. In addition, an approximately 3-nm-thick MoOx overlayer stabilizes the plasmonic response for at least seven months under ambient conditions. These results establish oxide/graphene heterostructures as a robust platform compatible with scalable fabrication, providing a pathway toward stable and tunable infrared nanophotonic and optoelectronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到使用散射型扫描近场光学显微镜（s-SNOM）进行测量，并涉及物理气相沉积、静电门控等实验手段。；研究对象：氧化物/石墨烯异质结构（具体为MoOx/石墨烯和ZnOx/石墨烯异质结）中的红外表面等离激元极化激元，以及界面电荷转移对其光学和电子性质的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超薄MoOx覆盖层通过界面电荷转移显著增强石墨烯等离激元响应（更长的等离激元波长、更强的条纹对比度和更低的阻尼），而随后沉积的ZnOx覆盖层可部分逆转这一效应；约3 nm厚的MoOx覆盖层还能在环境条件下稳定等离激元响应至少7个月。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超薄MoOx覆盖层通过界面电荷转移显著增强石墨烯等离激元响应（更长的等离激元波长、更强的条纹对比度和更低的阻尼），而随后沉积的ZnOx覆盖层可部分逆转这一效应；约3 nm厚的MoOx覆盖层还能在环境条件下稳定等离激元响应至少7个月。；创新点：利用氧化物/石墨烯异质结中的界面电荷转移实现对石墨烯等离激元的系统性工程调控，展示了可规模化制备的稳定可调红外纳米光子平台，并揭示了亚纳米厚度下电荷转移掺杂的快速增强及后续长程弱贡献的双尺度行为。
papers.method_zh: 散射型扫描近场光学显微镜（s-SNOM）进行红外纳米成像；物理气相沉积制备超薄氧化物覆盖层；能量依赖的纳米红外成像结合定量模型分析；厚度依赖测量；静电门控调控载流子密度。

papers.title: Transport interpretation of entanglement Hamiltonian cumulants in integrable quantum quenches
papers.abstract: We study the dynamics of the cumulants of the entanglement Hamiltonian in interacting integrable models following global quantum quenches. Building on recent results based on space-time duality, we show that these cumulants are exactly given by the cumulants of currents of suitable conserved charges evaluated in the macrostate selected by the initial state. This establishes a direct connection between entanglement dynamics and transport, providing a transport counterpart to the quasiparticle picture that successfully describes the evolution of the von Neumann entropy. In the free-fermion and conformal limits, our results reduce to the difference between the current cumulants carried by right- and left-moving excitations, recovering previously known expressions. In interacting integrable models, where a decomposition into independent right and left movers is no longer meaningful at the operator level, a similar structure survives at the level of the entanglement spectrum, yielding a unified description of entanglement Hamiltonian fluctuations across free, conformal, and interacting integrable systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“We study the dynamics”“we show that”“based on space-time duality”，属于解析理论推导，无实验或数值计算关键词。；研究对象：可积相互作用模型（interacting integrable models）在全局量子淬火（global quantum quenches）后纠缠哈密顿量（entanglement Hamiltonian）累积量（cumulants）的动力学。具体涉及自由费米子、共形场论极限以及一般可积相互作用体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 纠缠哈密顿量的累积量在可积模型淬火动力学中精确等于由初态所确定的宏观态（macrostate）中相应守恒荷电流的累积量，从而建立了纠缠动力学与输运之间的直接对应关系。该对应在自由费米子和共形极限下退化为左右移动激发电流累积量之差，而在相互作用可积模型中，这一结构在纠缠谱层面仍然成立。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：纠缠哈密顿量的累积量在可积模型淬火动力学中精确等于由初态所确定的宏观态（macrostate）中相应守恒荷电流的累积量，从而建立了纠缠动力学与输运之间的直接对应关系。该对应在自由费米子和共形极限下退化为左右移动激发电流累积量之差，而在相互作用可积模型中，这一结构在纠缠谱层面仍然成立。；创新点：首次将纠缠哈密顿量累积量的动力学精确映射为守恒荷电流的累积量，为纠缠动力学提供了输运层面的对应物（transport counterpart），补充了仅描述冯·诺依曼熵演化的准粒子图像。该统一描述覆盖了自由、共形和相互作用可积系统，在相互作用情形下虽无法在算符层面分解为左右独立传播子，但在纠缠谱层面仍保持类似结构。
papers.method_zh: 基于时空对偶性（space-time duality）的解析理论框架，结合准粒子图像（quasiparticle picture）的输运类比。具体推导了纠缠哈密顿量累积量的演化公式，并在自由费米子、共形场论和相互作用可积模型三个层次上验证了公式的普适形式。

papers.title: Thermal DMRG for quasi one-dimensional magnetic molecules and chains
papers.abstract: Density matrix renormalization group methods or tensor network methods in general can not only be used to determine ground states but also to evaluate thermal equilibrium properties. Although convergence is superior for one-dimensional quantum spin systems with nearest neighbor exchange and open boundary conditions, the hope is that these methods can as well be employed to approximate magnetic observables of magnetic molecules with more complex interaction patterns. Here, we study the accuracy that can realistically be achieved for several archetypical quasi one-dimensional structures using the TenPy suite. In our study, we aim at systems that are too large for exact diagonalization or Krylov space methods.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：DMRG（密度矩阵重正化群）、tensor network methods、TenPy suite。；研究对象：准一维磁性分子与自旋链体系，具体为具有复杂交换作用模式的磁性分子，以及尺寸过大而无法用精确对角化或Krylov空间方法处理的一维量子自旋系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确给出具体的物理结论，主要关注点在于评估热DMRG方法在准一维磁性分子结构上实际可达到的计算精度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确给出具体的物理结论，主要关注点在于评估热DMRG方法在准一维磁性分子结构上实际可达到的计算精度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其新意在于将热DMRG方法从标准的一维最近邻交换开放边界自旋链，推广应用到具有更复杂交换作用模式的磁性分子体系，并系统评估其精度。
papers.method_zh: 热力学密度矩阵重正化群（thermal DMRG）方法，基于张量网络形式，使用TenPy软件套件进行计算模拟。

papers.title: Interface-Controlled Defect Engineering in TiN/TaN Superlattices for Enhanced Hardness and Fracture Toughness
papers.abstract: TiNTaN superlattice coatings were designed to investigate how atomic-scale interface chemistry and defect-stabilized TaN layers govern hardness and fracture toughness. Guided by first-principles predictions identifying TaN-based layers as more damage tolerant than TiN, coherent superlattices with a bilayer period of 6 nm were synthesized by reactive magnetron sputtering and interfacially doped with C, B, or Si. Structural and chemical analyses reveal coherent fcc architectures with well-defined interfaces. Si segregates preferentially to the interfaces while incorporating into both TiN and TaN, whereas C and B predominantly diffuse into the TaN layers, modifying coherency strain, bonding, and defect populations. Consequently, hardness increases from 34 GPa for the undoped superlattice to 41 GPa for the Si-doped architecture, whereas fracture toughness increases from 2.8 to 4.0 MPam0.5 for the B-doped superlattice. First-principles calculations show that vacancy-stabilized TaxNy enhances elastic compliance and elastic contrast rather than intrinsic toughness, while the additional toughening induced by B indicates localized defect-assisted energy dissipation at chemically engineered interfaces. Thus, Si maximizes interface strengthening, whereas B provides the most favourable hardness-toughness balance while preserving high hardness, 38 GPa. These findings establish interface chemistry as an additional design parameter for tailoring the mechanical performance of ceramic nitride superlattices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+第一性原理计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“reactive magnetron sputtering”实验合成与表征，以及“first-principles calculations”第一性原理计算。；研究对象：TiN/TaN超晶格涂层，重点研究原子级界面化学（C、B、Si界面掺杂）与缺陷稳定化TaN层对硬度与断裂韧性的调控机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Si界面掺杂使硬度从34 GPa提升至41 GPa（界面强化最优），而B掺杂使断裂韧性从2.8提升至4.0 MPa·m^0.5，同时保持38 GPa的高硬度，实现了最佳的硬度-韧性平衡。第一性原理计算表明，空位稳定的TaxNy主要增强弹性柔度和弹性对比度而非本征韧性，B掺杂的额外增韧机制源于化学工程界面处的局域缺陷辅助能量耗散。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Si界面掺杂使硬度从34 GPa提升至41 GPa（界面强化最优），而B掺杂使断裂韧性从2.8提升至4.0 MPa·m^0.5，同时保持38 GPa的高硬度，实现了最佳的硬度-韧性平衡。第一性原理计算表明，空位稳定的TaxNy主要增强弹性柔度和弹性对比度而非本征韧性，B掺杂的额外增韧机制源于化学工程界面处的局域缺陷辅助能量耗散。；创新点：将界面化学（掺杂元素种类及偏析行为）确立为陶瓷氮化物超晶格力学性能设计的额外调控参数，区分了不同掺杂元素（Si vs B）对强化与增韧的不同微观机制贡献。
papers.method_zh: 反应磁控溅射（reactive magnetron sputtering）合成周期6 nm的共格超晶格；结构/化学表征（结构分析揭示共格fcc结构及界面元素分布）；第一性原理计算（预测TaN基层的损伤容限、计算空位稳定化效应及弹性性质）。

papers.title: Disorder-tuned crossing of monopole and conventional pairing instabilities in multi-Weyl semimetals
papers.abstract: We study how non-magnetic impurity scattering affects the emergence and possible coexistence of pairing instabilities in a two-node multi-Weyl semimetal. Within an explicitly specified projected impurity kernel---valley diagonal and momentum independent across each Fermi pocket, the leading behaviour of non-magnetic disorder in the small-pocket window $q^{\max}_{\rm intra}ξ_{\rm dis}\ll1\ll|2\mathbf Q|ξ_{\rm dis}$, treated at leading order in Born and Abrikosov--Gor'kov theory---quenched disorder tunes the leading pairing instability from a topologically nontrivial monopole channel to a conventional ($s$-wave) one, extending our earlier clean-system analysis into the disordered regime. A Born self-energy calculation in the chiral band basis then gives: (i) a band-isotropic conventional channel that is Anderson protected against intra-node scalar disorder ($η_s=1$), introduced phenomenologically at the projected-band level; solving the competition for arbitrary $η_s$ yields the crossing criterion $(1-η_s)/(1-η_m)<T_{c0}^{(s)}/T_{c0}^{(m)}$, so the mechanism tolerates substantial loss of conventional-channel protection; and (ii) a rank-one monopole sector fixing $f_m$ as the exact eigenfunction with $η_m(J)=1/(J+2)$, exact given that kernel. The crossing location in $Γ_N/T_{c0}^{(m)}$ is set by $η_m(J)$, $η_s$, and $r=T_{c0}^{(s)}/T_{c0}^{(m)}$. From the clean projected BdG Hamiltonian the pure monopole nodes carry Berry charge $\pm J$, distinct from the gapped conventional solution; the clean nodal thermodynamics is charge-dependent, $N_{\rm SC}(E)\propto E^{2/J}$ and $C\propto T^{1+2/J}$, and the residual density of states shows a threshold only for $J=1$. The crossing lies in the moderately metallic regime, $μ/Γ_N\simeq11$--$14$ for the illustrative $T_{c0}^{(m)}/μ=0.133$ used in the figures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：We study、Born self-energy calculation、theoretical analysis、BdG Hamiltonian。；研究对象：双节点多Weyl半金属（multi-Weyl semimetal）中的非磁性杂质散射对配对不稳定性的影响，具体关注拓扑非平庸的monopole配对通道与常规s波配对通道之间的竞争与交叉。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在特定投影杂质核下，非磁性无序可将主导配对不稳定性从拓扑非平庸的monopole通道调至常规s波通道；两通道的交叉判据为 (1−η_s)/(1−η_m) < T_{c0}^{(s)}/T_{c0}^{(m)}，且交叉点位于中等金属性区间（μ/Γ_N ≈ 11–14）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在特定投影杂质核下，非磁性无序可将主导配对不稳定性从拓扑非平庸的monopole通道调至常规s波通道；两通道的交叉判据为 (1−η_s)/(1−η_m) < T_{c0}^{(s)}/T_{c0}^{(m)}，且交叉点位于中等金属性区间（μ/Γ_N ≈ 11–14）。；创新点：将此前干净体系的多Weyl半金属配对分析推广到无序区，明确给出了无序调制的monopole-to-s波配对交叉判据，并揭示了monopole通道的秩一结构（η_m(J)=1/(J+2)）以及常规通道的Anderson保护特性（η_s=1）及其对保护损失的容忍度。摘要未突出说明与其他无序配对研究的对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用Born近似和Abrikosov–Gor'kov理论处理无序，在手性能带基下进行Born自能计算；使用投影杂质核（谷对角、每个费米口袋内动量无关）；基于干净的投影BdG哈密顿量分析节点拓扑性质与热力学。

papers.title: Intervalley Magnetotrions Tunable by Electric and Magnetic Fields in Buckled Two-Dimensional Materials
papers.abstract: We develop a theoretical framework for intervalley magnetotrions in buckled two-dimensional materials, including silicene, germanene, and stanene, subjected to perpendicular electric and magnetic fields. Within the effective-mass approximation, the three-particle Schrödinger equation is formulated with the Rytova--Keldysh interaction potential and analyzed in the high-magnetic-field regime. We demonstrate that intervalley trions with equal electron and hole effective masses constitute an exceptional case for which the center-of-mass and internal motions separate exactly. The center-of-mass motion is governed by a two-dimensional harmonic-oscillator Hamiltonian, leading to quantized Landau states whose energies form electrically tunable Landau surfaces controlled by the magnetic field and the electric-field dependence of the carrier effective masses. The internal motion is investigated by solving the three-body Schrödinger equation within the framework of the hyperspherical harmonics method. Numerical calculations reveal that the trion binding energy increases monotonically with both magnetic and electric fields owing to the combined effects of magnetic confinement and electric-field-induced enhancement of the effective masses. The strongest binding is obtained for silicene, followed by stanene and germanene. The present work provides a unified description of both the collective center-of-mass motion and the internal dynamics of magnetotrions in Xene monolayers, demonstrating that both degrees of freedom can be independently manipulated by external electric and magnetic fields.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“develop a theoretical framework”“effective-mass approximation”“Schrödinger equation”“hyperspherical harmonics method”等理论推导与数值求解关键词。；研究对象：褶皱二维材料（硅烯、锗烯、锡烯）中的谷间磁激子（intervalley magnetotrions），即由两个电子和一个空穴组成的三粒子束缚态，在垂直电场和磁场作用下的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 谷间三激子的质心运动与内部运动可精确分离，质心运动对应可电调谐的朗道能级面；三激子束缚能随磁场和电场单调增大，其中硅烯中束缚最强，其次为锡烯和锗烯。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：谷间三激子的质心运动与内部运动可精确分离，质心运动对应可电调谐的朗道能级面；三激子束缚能随磁场和电场单调增大，其中硅烯中束缚最强，其次为锡烯和锗烯。；创新点：首次对Xene单层中磁三激子的质心集体运动与内部动力学给出统一描述，并证明两者可分别由外电场和磁场独立调控；特别指出电子与空穴有效质量相等时谷间三激子可实现质心与内部运动的精确分离。
papers.method_zh: 有效质量近似下建立三粒子薛定谔方程，采用Rytova–Keldysh相互作用势，在高磁场区间求解；质心运动化为二维谐振子问题，内部运动用超球谐函数方法数值求解三体薛定谔方程。

papers.title: Phoretic interactions in two-medium wedge geometries
papers.abstract: We investigate the diffusiophoretic motion of a chemically isotropic active colloid in a three-dimensional wedge formed by two distinct fluid media, in the limit of vanishing Péclet and Reynolds numbers. The concentration field is obtained using the Fourier-Kontorovich-Lebedev transform, yielding an exact representation for arbitrary wedge opening angles and interfacial contrasts. We introduce the interfacial parameter $Γ=(1-λ\ell)/(1+λ\ell)$, where $λ$ denotes the diffusivity contrast and $\ell$ the solute partition coefficient. For $Γ=\pm1$ and commensurate wedge angles, the solution reduces to finite image constructions, with distinct structures for even and odd commensurability. The general solution also recovers the planar-interface and semi-infinite-interface limits. The leading-order translational phoretic velocity is derived from the concentration field, revealing a strong interplay between wedge geometry and interfacial properties that governs both the magnitude and direction of particle motion. This work provides a framework for understanding and controlling phoretic transport in confined multiphase environments and offer a basis for extensions to finite-size geometries and mixed fluid--fluid and solid boundary conditions. Our results may find applications in the control of active-particle transport in confined multiphase environments, where interfacial properties and geometry can be exploited to tune phoretic motion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“Fourier-Kontorovich-Lebedev变换”“精确表示”“推导”等理论分析关键词，且未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：由两种不同流体介质构成的三维楔形几何中的化学各向同性活性胶体，具体研究其扩散泳运动（diffusiophoretic motion），属于活性物质输运与多相流体界面物理交叉领域。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 楔形几何与界面性质（由界面参数Γ表征）的强耦合共同决定活性胶体平移泳动速度的大小与方向；在Γ=±1且楔角满足可公度条件时，解可简化为有限镜像构造，且偶/奇可公度性对应不同结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：楔形几何与界面性质（由界面参数Γ表征）的强耦合共同决定活性胶体平移泳动速度的大小与方向；在Γ=±1且楔角满足可公度条件时，解可简化为有限镜像构造，且偶/奇可公度性对应不同结构。；创新点：首次给出了两种不同流体介质构成的三维楔形几何中扩散泳运动的精确解析解，引入了界面参数Γ统一刻画扩散率对比与溶质分配系数的影响，并揭示了可公度楔角下有限镜像构造的偶奇性差异。摘要未突出说明与已有楔形几何中单一介质或单一界面研究的系统性对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论解析方法：在Péclet数和Reynolds数均为零的极限下，利用Fourier-Kontorovich-Lebedev变换求解浓度场，得到任意楔角和界面对比度下的精确解；进而从浓度场推导领头阶平移泳动速度。同时验证了平面界面和半无限界面极限的恢复。

papers.title: Floquet engineering of spin-valley selective transport in jacutingaite
papers.abstract: We study electron transport through a monolayer jacutingaite (Pt$_2$HgSe$_3$) tunnel junction in which only the barrier is irradiated by off-resonant circularly polarized light, while the leads remain undriven. In the high-frequency regime, the driven barrier reduces to an effective static Dirac Hamiltonian with a photon-dressed, valley-dependent mass term. A staggered sublattice potential $V_z$ and a substrate-induced exchange field $m_s$ provide additional tunable mass terms. Using scattering theory, we compute spin- and valley-resolved transmission and reflection, as well as the Landauer conductance. Photon dressing shifts the barrier {Dirac masses} with opposite signs in the ($\boldsymbol{K}, \boldsymbol{K}'$) valleys and induces a splitting of the propagation thresholds. The finite barrier then produces channel-dependent Fabry--Pérot-type interference through the phase $q_x^{ηs_z}L$. We find broad parameter windows with near-perfect valley filtering ($|P_v|\simeq 100\%$) and substantial spin polarization ($|P_s|\sim 70\%$). The dominant spin and valley polarizations can be switched by tuning the drive amplitude $A_0$, $V_z$, and~$m_s$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“scattering theory”（散射理论）、“Landauer conductance”（兰道尔电导）等理论工具，且未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：单层jacutingaite（Pt₂HgSe₃）隧道结，其中仅势垒区域被非共振圆偏振光照射，两侧电极无驱动。研究体系为光驱动下的自旋-谷极化电子输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过Floquet工程，光子修饰在K和K'谷中产生符号相反的狄拉克质量移动，导致传播阈值劈裂，从而实现近完美的谷过滤（|P_v|≈100%）和可观的自旋极化（|P_s|≈70%）。自旋和谷极化的主导方向可通过调节驱动幅度A₀、交错子格势V_z和衬底交换场m_s进行切换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过Floquet工程，光子修饰在K和K'谷中产生符号相反的狄拉克质量移动，导致传播阈值劈裂，从而实现近完美的谷过滤（|P_v|≈100%）和可观的自旋极化（|P_s|≈70%）。自旋和谷极化的主导方向可通过调节驱动幅度A₀、交错子格势V_z和衬底交换场m_s进行切换。；创新点：首次在jacutingaite体系中实现仅对势垒区域进行光驱动（而非整个器件）的Floquet工程方案，利用光子修饰质量项与V_z、m_s的协同作用，在单一材料中同时实现可切换的高效谷过滤和自旋极化。摘要未突出说明与已有光驱动输运研究的其他对比。
papers.method_zh: 高频率近似下将驱动势垒约化为含光子修饰、谷依赖质量项的有效静态狄拉克哈密顿量；结合散射理论计算自旋分辨和谷分辨的透射/反射系数及兰道尔电导；分析有限势垒中通过相位q_x^{ηs_z}L产生的通道依赖的Fabry–Pérot型干涉。

papers.title: Dynamic quantum phase transitions in the two-leg Creutz ladder with long-range hopping
papers.abstract: In this work, we investigate quantum quenches in the two-leg Creutz model with long-range hopping, where the hopping amplitudes decay with distance as a power law characterized by an exponent $ν$ and have a finite range $D$. We first obtain the exact solution of a generic two-band model in momentum space. This allows us to compute the Loschmidt amplitude and, consequently, the dynamical free energy $f(\texttt{t})$ of the two-band model. We also show how to determine the Yang-Lee Fisher (YLF) zeros by solving a nonlinear equation. We demonstrate that the two-leg Creutz model in momentum space is a special case of the generic two-band model. Using these results, we identify the non-analyticities in the dynamical free energy $f(\texttt{t})$ at critical times $\texttt{t}_{c}$. We find that the number of nontrivial critical times $N_{s}$ depends on both $ν$ and $D$. In particular, we show that for small $ν$ and large $D$ the critical times become increasingly dense, leading, in the appropriate regime, to non-analyticities at an increasingly dense set of times---similar to what was observed by Xavier and Hoyos [Phys.
