papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在有限p>2的整个考察范围内，铁磁—自旋玻璃相边界在三临界点附近是重入的；由此逻辑关系可推出自旋玻璃相内至少存在一对不同温度使自旋构型重叠为零，且进一步强烈暗示所有温度对的重叠均为零，即存在温度混沌。；创新点：将此前建立的“重入相变与温度混沌之间的逻辑关系”［Phys. Rev. E 112, 044140 (2025)］首次显式应用于全连接Ising p-自旋玻璃模型，给出该关系的具体解析实例，并推广到所有有限p>2。
papers.method_zh: 围绕三临界点对自由能进行解析展开（free energy expansion around the triple point），并结合两温度复制计算（two-temperature replica calculation）提供独立证据。

papers.title: Nonequilibrium pulse dynamics and metastable latching in nonlinear kinetic inductance detectors
papers.abstract: Microwave kinetic inductance detectors are typically operated at high readout power to raise the detector signal above system noise. At sufficiently large readout power, the current-dependent kinetic inductance couples the detector response to its readout bias. Using a nonlinear resonator framework and time-domain circuit calculations, we show that the amplitude, shape, and relaxation time of the driven detector's response depend on both the absorbed energy and on the readout bias. Strongly driven bias points produce amplified, extended, and non-exponential pulse responses. Qualitative agreement between calculated and measured pulse responses indicates that these effects are dominated by the driven nonlinear resonator dynamics rather than by altered quasiparticle dynamics. Beyond resonance bifurcation, sufficiently large pulse events drive the resonator between stable branches, resulting in a metastable latched state which persists after the quasiparticle transient has decayed. The pulse energy required for branch switching is set by the readout bias, suggesting a mode of triggered detection with an in-situ tunable threshold. Although nonlinear operation requires calibration of the bias- and energy-dependent response, the enhanced pulse amplitude and duration, together with tunable latching and the ability to select these parameters via the readout operating state, are likely to be of interest for single-photon and rare-event experiments, especially those limited by amplifier or system noise.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“nonlinear resonator framework and time-domain circuit calculations”，即使用非线性谐振器框架和时域电路计算，属于理论建模与数值模拟研究。；研究对象：微波动力学电感探测器（MKID）在强读出功率下的非线性响应行为，具体研究其脉冲响应幅度、形状、弛豫时间与吸收能量及读出偏置的耦合关系，以及共振分岔导致的亚稳态锁定现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强驱动偏置下，探测器的脉冲响应会被放大、延长并呈现非指数形状；足够大的脉冲事件可使谐振器在两个稳定分支间切换，形成在准粒子瞬态衰减后仍持续存在的亚稳态锁定态，且触发分支切换所需的脉冲能量可由读出偏置原位调节。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强驱动偏置下，探测器的脉冲响应会被放大、延长并呈现非指数形状；足够大的脉冲事件可使谐振器在两个稳定分支间切换，形成在准粒子瞬态衰减后仍持续存在的亚稳态锁定态，且触发分支切换所需的脉冲能量可由读出偏置原位调节。；创新点：揭示了强读出功率下MKID的非线性动力学（而非准粒子动力学改变）主导了异常脉冲响应，并提出一种基于分支切换的可调阈值触发探测模式，其阈值可通过读出工作点原位调节，对噪声受限的单光子与稀有事件实验具有潜在价值。
papers.method_zh: 非线性谐振器理论框架 + 时域电路数值计算；并与实验测量的脉冲响应进行定性对比验证。

papers.title: Quantum encoding of structured light into in-plane topological spin textures
papers.abstract: Structured light offers a powerful means of controlling light-matter interactions through multiple tunable optical degrees of freedom. Using micromagnetic simulations, we investigate the nucleation of asymmetric bimerons and antibimerons by pulsed Laguerre-Gaussian optical vortices in chiral ferromagnetic thin films with $C_{nv}$ and $D_{2d}$ symmetries, respectively. For optical vortices with orbital angular momentum (OAM) $|m|=1$, circularly polarized beams deterministically nucleate a single bimeron or antibimeron via the interplay of spin angular momentum, OAM, and magnetic chirality, whereas linearly polarized beams produce textures whose topological charge directly follows the OAM ($Q=m$). Optical vortices with OAM $|m|>1$ nucleate clusters and other configurations composed of multiple spin textures, whose morphology and topological charge depend sensitively on the optical quantum numbers and pulse parameters. These findings reveal a route to topology-selective writing through the encoding of optical quantum numbers into distinct in-plane topological magnetic states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“micromagnetic simulations”（微磁模拟）。；研究对象：手性铁磁薄膜中由拉盖尔-高斯光学涡旋脉冲诱导的面内拓扑自旋纹理，具体包括非对称双半子（bimeron）和反双半子（antibimeron），材料分别具有 Cₙᵥ 和 D₂𝒹 对称性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 携带轨道角动量（OAM）的圆偏振光学涡旋可确定性产生单个双半子或反双半子，而线偏振涡旋产生的自旋纹理拓扑荷直接等于 OAM 量子数（Q=m）；OAM |m|>1 时可产生多纹理团簇，其形貌和拓扑荷敏感依赖于光学量子数和脉冲参数，从而实现光学量子数到面内拓扑磁态的编码写入。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：携带轨道角动量（OAM）的圆偏振光学涡旋可确定性产生单个双半子或反双半子，而线偏振涡旋产生的自旋纹理拓扑荷直接等于 OAM 量子数（Q=m）；OAM |m|>1 时可产生多纹理团簇，其形貌和拓扑荷敏感依赖于光学量子数和脉冲参数，从而实现光学量子数到面内拓扑磁态的编码写入。；创新点：揭示了通过光学涡旋的量子数（OAM、偏振）选择性写入不同拓扑荷的面内磁纹理（双半子/反双半子）的机制，实现了“拓扑选择性写入”，即光学量子数到拓扑磁态的编码映射。
papers.method_zh: 微磁模拟（micromagnetic simulations），研究脉冲拉盖尔-高斯光学涡旋与手性铁磁薄膜的相互作用，分析了自旋角动量、轨道角动量与磁手性之间的耦合效应。

papers.title: Spectrally Programmable Spin-Polarized Photocurrents in WSe$_2$-NiPS$_3$ Magnetic van der Waals Heterostructures
papers.abstract: Efficient generation and control of spin-polarized currents in semiconductors remain central challenges for spin-based electronics, particularly due to impedance mismatch and the reliance on magnetic fields or ferromagnetic contacts. Here, we introduce a materials platform for spectrally programmable spin transport based on a van der Waals heterostructure combining the antiferromagnetic semiconductor NiPS$_3$ with WSe$_2$. In a p-n diode architecture, circularly polarized excitation produces pronounced photoconductive resonances with spin polarization reaching 80% near the Neel temperature and persisting at 30% at room temperature. Remarkably, selected spectral bands retain their polarization sign across the magnetic phase transition, evidencing robust, spectrally protected spin-polarized current generation. Polarization-resolved photogalvanic measurements reveal a dominant circular injection-current mechanism, confirming spin-polarized carrier transport. First-principles calculations show that an applied electric field induces interfacial hybridization and spin-layer locking, giving rise to localized symmetry breaking and enhanced optical absorption while preserving global time-reversal symmetry. These results establish spectral tuning of excitation as a new control knob for spin transport, enabling spin-current generation without magnetic fields or polarization switching. Our findings position magnetic van der Waals heterostructures as a versatile platform for opto-spintronic functionality and spectrally programmable spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+第一性原理计算）。判断依据：摘要中提及“偏振分辨光电流测量”“圆偏振激发”等实验手段，以及“第一性原理计算”明确表明包含理论计算。；研究对象：WSe₂-NiPS₃ 磁性范德华异质结，具体研究其p-n二极管结构中的自旋极化光电流产生与调控，以及自旋输运与磁相变、光谱选择性的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在WSe₂-NiPS₃异质结中，圆偏振光激发可产生自旋极化度高达80%（近奈尔温度）且室温下仍保持30%的自旋极化光电流；特定光谱波段的自旋极化符号在磁相变前后保持不变，实现了无需外磁场的光谱可编程自旋电流产生。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在WSe₂-NiPS₃异质结中，圆偏振光激发可产生自旋极化度高达80%（近奈尔温度）且室温下仍保持30%的自旋极化光电流；特定光谱波段的自旋极化符号在磁相变前后保持不变，实现了无需外磁场的光谱可编程自旋电流产生。；创新点：首次提出利用激发光谱作为自旋输运的调控自由度（“光谱可编程”），在磁性范德华异质结中实现无需磁场或铁磁接触的自旋电流产生，且自旋极化符号受光谱保护、跨越磁相变保持稳定。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用p-n二极管器件架构，进行圆偏振光激发下的光导共振测量、偏振分辨光电流（光电流效应）测量；理论上采用第一性原理计算，研究外加电场下的界面杂化与自旋-层锁定效应。

papers.title: Intertwined spin-charge stripe order and polar lattice distortion in La$_{3}$Ni$_{2}$O$_{7}$
papers.abstract: The low-temperature density-wave state of La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ hosts pronounced spin-density-wave (SDW) order, while recent experiments further reveal charge redistribution and a concomitant lattice-symmetry lowering. However, the microscopic relationship among spin, charge, and lattice remains unclear. Using first-principles calculations, we investigate the pressure evolution of the electronic structure and static spin susceptibility of La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$, together with the energetics and lattice response of representative magnetic configurations. We trace the SDW instability to strong Fermi-surface nesting and find that the high-pressure spin response closely tracks $T_{\mathrm C}$, suggesting spin-fluctuation-mediated pairing. Among the candidate magnetic states considered, the spin-charge-stripe states emerge as energetically favored and dynamically stable, developing pronounced disproportionation of both the local Ni moments and the Ni--O bond lengths. Remarkably, the lowest-energy a-stripe state spontaneously relaxes into the experimentally proposed polar Am2m structure through a polar distortion along the b axis. These results establish a unified picture in which spin, charge, and lattice responses are strongly intertwined in the low-pressure density-wave state, while spin fluctuations remain a plausible ingredient of superconductivity under pressure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算），并涉及电子结构、静态自旋磁化率、能量学与晶格响应等计算内容。；研究对象：研究对象为双层镍氧化物La₃Ni₂O₇，具体聚焦于其低温密度波态中自旋密度波（SDW）序、电荷重分布与晶格对称性降低之间的微观关联，以及压力下自旋涨落与超导电性的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: La₃Ni₂O₇的SDW不稳定性源于强费米面嵌套，且高压下的自旋响应紧密跟随超导转变温度T_C，支持自旋涨落介导的超导配对机制；在候选磁构型中，自旋-电荷条纹态能量上有利且动力学稳定，其中最低能量的a-条纹态自发弛豫为实验提出的极性Am2m结构，表明自旋、电荷与晶格响应在低压密度波态中强烈交织。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：La₃Ni₂O₇的SDW不稳定性源于强费米面嵌套，且高压下的自旋响应紧密跟随超导转变温度T_C，支持自旋涨落介导的超导配对机制；在候选磁构型中，自旋-电荷条纹态能量上有利且动力学稳定，其中最低能量的a-条纹态自发弛豫为实验提出的极性Am2m结构，表明自旋、电荷与晶格响应在低压密度波态中强烈交织。；创新点：首次在La₃Ni₂O₇中建立了自旋、电荷与晶格自由度在密度波态中相互交织的统一图像，并发现自旋-电荷条纹态自发产生极性晶格畸变（Am2m结构），将磁有序与实验观测到的极性结构直接联系起来；同时将高压自旋响应与T_C的关联作为自旋涨落介导超导的证据。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理计算（DFT类方法），具体包括：计算电子结构随压力的演化、静态自旋磁化率（用于分析费米面嵌套与SDW不稳定性）、评估多种代表性磁构型的能量学与晶格响应，并考察磁有序态下的结构弛豫（包括Ni局域磁矩与Ni–O键长的歧化）。

papers.title: Can Strain or Anion Interchange Make an Unstable Structure Stable? Energetics, Lattice Dynamics and Strain-Tunable Band Gaps of Lithium Chalcohalide Antiperovskites (Li$_{3}$$BA$) and their Anion Interchange Variants (Li$_{3}$$AB$)
papers.abstract: Lithium chalcohalide antiperovskites are a promising, non-toxic alternative to lead halide perovskites, with potential as solid electrolytes for Li-ion batteries. we computationally investigate a relatively unexplored anion-interchange mechanism by which cubic Li$_{3}$$AB$ derivatives are obtained from the parent cubic antiperovskite Li$_{3}$$BA$ ($A$ = O, S, Se, Te, Po; $B$ = F, Cl, Br, I). The calculated relative energy landscape provides a useful guide for anion-site selectivity and its role in structural stability. The energetic stability results reveal that the smaller anion inside the octahedron stabilizes the structures. The lattice-dynamic calculations confirm that Li$_{3}$F$A$ ($A$ = Te, Po) and Li$_{3}$O$B$ ($B$ = Cl, Br, I), which are the most energetically stable compounds, are dynamically stable cubic phases without imaginary phonon modes. However, Li$_{3}$FS and Li$_{3}$FSe, while energetically stable, are dynamically unstable at equilibrium and become dynamically stable under triaxial compressive strain. In addition, we report the electronic structure and density of states (DOS) of all compounds, which show a substantial change in band gap upon anion interchange. The strain engineering of the lithium chalcohalide family illustrates how a few percent of the strain can tune the electronic band gap within the electrochemical stability window for solid battery applications. This study unveils essential characteristics of the anion site-interchange mechanism and provides a foundation for the understanding and design of lithium chalcohalide antiperovskites.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：摘要中明确使用“computationally investigate”“calculated relative energy landscape”“lattice-dynamic calculations”等关键词，属于第一性原理计算研究。；研究对象：锂硫卤化物反钙钛矿材料Li₃BA（A = O, S, Se, Te, Po；B = F, Cl, Br, I）及其阴离子互换变体Li₃AB，重点关注其结构稳定性、晶格动力学、电子结构与应变调控的带隙。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 阴离子互换后，较小的阴离子占据八面体内部位置可稳定结构；Li₃FTe、Li₃FPo、Li₃OCl、Li₃OBr、Li₃OI为动态稳定的立方相，而Li₃FS和Li₃FSe在平衡态下动态不稳定，但可通过三轴压缩应变实现动态稳定。阴离子互换显著改变带隙，少量应变即可在电化学稳定窗口内调控带隙。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：阴离子互换后，较小的阴离子占据八面体内部位置可稳定结构；Li₃FTe、Li₃FPo、Li₃OCl、Li₃OBr、Li₃OI为动态稳定的立方相，而Li₃FS和Li₃FSe在平衡态下动态不稳定，但可通过三轴压缩应变实现动态稳定。阴离子互换显著改变带隙，少量应变即可在电化学稳定窗口内调控带隙。；创新点：系统研究了此前较少探索的阴离子互换机制对锂硫卤化物反钙钛矿结构稳定性的影响，揭示了阴离子尺寸与位点选择对稳定性的决定性作用，并展示了应变作为调控动态稳定性和带隙的有效手段，为固态电池电解质材料设计提供了新思路。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理计算，具体包括：相对能量景观计算（用于评估阴离子位点选择性）、晶格动力学计算（声子谱分析，判断动态稳定性）、电子结构计算（能带与态密度DOS），以及应变工程模拟（三轴压缩应变对动态稳定性和带隙的影响）。

papers.title: Entropy Production Bounds the Accuracy of Computation in Markov Networks
papers.abstract: Biological and artificial networks compute by transforming time-dependent inputs into functional outputs. Because the internal state of a stochastic network relaxes on finite timescales, its output generally lags behind a changing environment, producing computational errors. We show that for reversible continuous-time Markov networks the error admits a universal thermodynamic bound. Decomposing the total error into representation and lag contributions, we derive an inequality relating the lag error to the entropy production rate and a memory time equal to the integrated equilibrium autocorrelation of the output observable. The bound implies that accurate dynamical computation requires either substantial dissipation or long-lived memory encoded in slowly relaxing modes. We demonstrate these principles in artificial Markov networks and in models of biochemical information processing. Our results establish a thermodynamic limit on information processing in stochastic networks and provide a quantitative framework for understanding the energetic costs of biological computation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：theoretical bound、inequality、thermodynamic limit、derive。；研究对象：随机马尔可夫网络中的计算过程，具体包括人工马尔可夫网络和生化信息处理模型，关注网络在时变输入下输出滞后导致的计算误差与热力学耗散之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于可逆连续时间马尔可夫网络，计算误差（特别是滞后误差）存在一个普适热力学下界：误差受熵产生率与输出可观测量的平衡自相关积分（记忆时间）之积约束，即精确的动态计算必须要么消耗大量耗散，要么依赖缓慢弛豫模式提供的长时记忆。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于可逆连续时间马尔可夫网络，计算误差（特别是滞后误差）存在一个普适热力学下界：误差受熵产生率与输出可观测量的平衡自相关积分（记忆时间）之积约束，即精确的动态计算必须要么消耗大量耗散，要么依赖缓慢弛豫模式提供的长时记忆。；创新点：首次建立了随机网络中信息处理精度的普适热力学极限，将计算误差与熵产生率通过记忆时间定量联系起来，为生物计算的能量代价提供了定量理论框架。摘要未突出说明与已有具体工作的对比差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：将总误差分解为表征误差（representation error）和滞后误差（lag error），利用连续时间马尔可夫链的可逆性条件，推导出滞后误差与熵产生率及平衡自相关记忆时间之间的不等式；并在人工马尔可夫网络和生化信息处理模型中进行数值演示。

papers.title: Weak irreducibility as a spectral criterion for phase coexistence
papers.abstract: Conventional finite-size theories describe first-order coexistence through free-energy competition and interfacial tunneling, but the distinct spectral roles of sector balance and inter-sector connectivity are not usually explicit. We show that pseudo-transitions and thermodynamic phase coexistence are governed by two spectral coordinates: sector imbalance locates balance, while connectivity determines whether that balance remains avoided. At balance, finite connectivity produces a unique dominant state with equal spectral weights in the symmetrized two-sector representation. For short-range systems with positive interface tension, interfacial costs suppress the connectivity exponentially, close the coexistence splitting, and asymptotically restore reducibility. Thus, genuine phase coexistence emerges as the singular limit of finite-size avoided coexistence, whereas one-dimensional pseudo-transitions retain finite connectivity. papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：finite-size theories、spectral coordinates、asymptotically restore reducibility、singular limit。；研究对象：一阶相共存（first-order coexistence）与伪相变（pseudo-transitions）的谱学判据，具体以装饰双层伊辛模型（decorated bilayer Ising model）为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 相共存由两个谱坐标共同决定：扇区不平衡（sector imbalance）定位平衡点，而扇区间连通性（connectivity）决定该平衡是否被避免。短程正界面张力体系下，界面代价使连通性指数压低，闭合共存劈裂并渐近恢复可约性，因此真实相共存是有限尺寸“回避共存”的奇异极限；而一维伪相变保持有限连通性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：相共存由两个谱坐标共同决定：扇区不平衡（sector imbalance）定位平衡点，而扇区间连通性（connectivity）决定该平衡是否被避免。短程正界面张力体系下，界面代价使连通性指数压低，闭合共存劈裂并渐近恢复可约性，因此真实相共存是有限尺寸“回避共存”的奇异极限；而一维伪相变保持有限连通性。；创新点：明确区分了扇区平衡（sector balance）与扇区间连通性（inter-sector connectivity）在谱上的不同作用，提出“弱不可约性”（weak irreducibility）作为相共存的谱判据，并将伪相变与真实相共存统一在有限尺寸回避共存的框架下。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，基于对称化双扇区表示（symmetrized two-sector representation）中的谱权重与连通性分析，结合有限尺寸标度论证，并在装饰双层伊辛模型中进行具体验证。

papers.title: Tunable Magnetic Frustration in the Cu-Ru-based Double Perovskite La$_{2-x}$Sm$_x$CuRuO$_6$ (x = 0, 1, 2) Oxides
papers.abstract: In this study, we investigate structural, magnetic, and electronic properties of the copper-ruthenate based oxide double perovskite La$_{2-x}$Sm$_x$CuRuO$_6$ (x = 0, 1, 2), synthesized through the solid-state reaction method. X-ray diffraction analysis reveals that all compounds crystallize in a monoclinic symmetry, with varying degree of structural distortion that increases in moving from La$^{3+}$ to smaller size cation Sm$^{3+}$. Electrical resistivity studies indicate insulating behaviour in all compounds, with variable-range-hopping domination at low temperatures, due to presence of anti-site disorder. AC susceptibility and heat capacity measurements suggest suppression of frustration in Sm-bearing compounds, affecting the magnetic behavior. Our first-principles calculations suggest that the combined effects of lattice distortion and Sm magnetism play a crucial role in weakening magnetic frustration, thereby rationalizing the experimental observations. These findings shed light on the complex interplay of crystal structure and magnetism in Cu-Ru double perovskites, and open up an avenue for tuning of magnetic properties through rare-earth-ion substitution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+第一性原理计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“solid-state reaction method”“X-ray diffraction”“AC susceptibility and heat capacity measurements”等实验手段，以及“first-principles calculations”理论计算。；研究对象：Cu-Ru基双钙钛矿氧化物 La₂₋ₓSmₓCuRuO₆（x = 0, 1, 2），具体研究其结构畸变、磁阻挫（magnetic frustration）以及磁性行为随稀土离子替换的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在La₂₋ₓSmₓCuRuO₆体系中，用较小的Sm³⁺替换La³⁺会增强结构畸变，并显著抑制磁阻挫效应；第一性原理计算表明，晶格畸变与Sm磁性的协同作用是削弱磁阻挫的关键机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在La₂₋ₓSmₓCuRuO₆体系中，用较小的Sm³⁺替换La³⁺会增强结构畸变，并显著抑制磁阻挫效应；第一性原理计算表明，晶格畸变与Sm磁性的协同作用是削弱磁阻挫的关键机制。；创新点：通过稀土离子（La→Sm）逐步替换，系统展示了晶格畸变与稀土局域磁矩共同作用可连续调控双钙钛矿中的磁阻挫强度，为通过稀土取代工程调节磁性提供了新途径。（摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。）
papers.method_zh: - 实验：固相反应法合成；X射线衍射（XRD）确定晶体结构与畸变程度；电阻率测量（确认绝缘行为及变程跳跃导电机制）；交流磁化率（AC susceptibility）与比热（heat capacity）测量用于表征磁阻挫与磁性行为。

papers.title: Observation of electron spin interactions between Rydberg atoms
papers.abstract: We report the observation of electron spin interactions between Rydberg atoms, which are driven by spin-orbit coupling through second-order dipole perturbation and exhibit a spatial anisotropy governed by the atomic configuration. Specifically, we observe coherent electron spin exchange dynamics, with the measured coupling strength agreeing well with both numerical calculations and theoretical models. Furthermore, we show that global microwave dressing enables active engineering and dynamical freezing of the spin exchange by introducing a differential AC Stark shift between the participating states. Additionally, we achieve tunability of the interaction by applying a stronger magnetic field, which effectively modifies the energy contributions of the underlying spin-orbit coupling channels. Finally, measuring spin dynamics in one-dimensional multi-atom chains aligned parallel or perpendicular to the magnetic field provides a self-consistent validation of the anisotropic XXZ framework. This electron spin interaction natively features spin-position coupling and enables a natural mapping onto the Heisenberg-Kitaev model. Our findings reveal a new class of electron spin-spin interactions among Rydberg atoms, expanding the scope of quantum simulation with Rydberg atom arrays.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“We report the observation”“measured coupling strength”“experimental”等实验观测关键词，并辅以数值计算与理论模型对比。；研究对象：里德伯原子体系中的电子自旋相互作用，具体为通过自旋-轨道耦合（二阶偶极微扰）驱动的电子自旋交换动力学，以及一维多原子链中的各向异性XXZ自旋模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次观测到里德伯原子间由自旋-轨道耦合介导的电子自旋交换相互作用，其耦合强度与数值计算和理论模型一致，且该相互作用具有空间各向异性，可映射到海森堡-基塔耶夫模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次观测到里德伯原子间由自旋-轨道耦合介导的电子自旋交换相互作用，其耦合强度与数值计算和理论模型一致，且该相互作用具有空间各向异性，可映射到海森堡-基塔耶夫模型。；创新点：揭示了里德伯原子中一类全新的电子自旋-自旋相互作用机制（区别于传统的偶极交换或接触相互作用），该相互作用天然具备自旋-位置耦合特性，并可直接映射到海森堡-基塔耶夫模型，拓展了里德伯原子阵列量子模拟的适用范围。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用里德伯原子阵列，通过全局微波缀饰引入差分交流斯塔克位移来实现自旋交换的主动调控与动力学冻结；通过施加强磁场调节自旋-轨道耦合通道的能量贡献；在一维原子链中沿平行或垂直于磁场方向测量自旋动力学，以验证各向异性XXZ框架。理论方面使用二阶偶极微扰和数值计算进行对比。

papers.title: Universal Spin-Position Coupled Rydberg Interactions
papers.abstract: Strong interactions between $s$-orbital Rydberg atoms underpin atom-array-based quantum computation and quantum simulation. Typically, the spin dependence of these interactions is negligible and plays no practical role. In this Letter, we uncover that a strong electron-spin-dependent Rydberg interaction can emerge when the principal quantum numbers of the two $s$-orbital atoms differ by a sweet-spot value. This interaction originates from the fine-structure splitting of nearby $p$ orbitals, which endows it with distinct symmetry properties such that the electron spins are coupled to the relative position of the two atoms, featuring a spatially defined anisotropy. We further demonstrate that this interaction admits a universal form, independent of the principal quantum numbers, and highlight its fundamental distinction from conventional magnetic dipolar interactions, establishing it as a new type of native magnetic interaction in nature. Our findings introduce a new element to the Rydberg quantum simulation toolbox. As a concrete application, we propose a native realization of the Kitaev-Heisenberg model, which hosts an unusual stripe phase as a quantum many-body manifestation of spin-space locking.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We uncover”“We further demonstrate”“We propose”等表述，且未提及实验手段或数值计算方法，属于理论提出与模型构建。；研究对象：Rydberg原子阵列中s轨道原子之间的电子自旋-位置耦合相互作用，具体涉及主量子数差为“甜点值”时的Rydberg相互作用，以及其在量子模拟中的应用（如Kitaev-Heisenberg模型）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当两个s轨道Rydberg原子的主量子数相差特定“甜点值”时，会出现强的电子自旋依赖的Rydberg相互作用，该相互作用将电子自旋与原子相对位置耦合，具有空间各向异性，且其形式具有普适性，独立于主量子数，是一种不同于传统磁偶极相互作用的新型本征磁性相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当两个s轨道Rydberg原子的主量子数相差特定“甜点值”时，会出现强的电子自旋依赖的Rydberg相互作用，该相互作用将电子自旋与原子相对位置耦合，具有空间各向异性，且其形式具有普适性，独立于主量子数，是一种不同于传统磁偶极相互作用的新型本征磁性相互作用。；创新点：首次揭示了一种由邻近p轨道精细结构劈裂诱导的、自旋-位置耦合的Rydberg相互作用，并证明其具有普适形式，区别于传统磁偶极相互作用；同时提出该相互作用可作为Rydberg量子模拟工具箱中的新元素，用于天然实现Kitaev-Heisenberg模型及其中的条纹相。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与模型构建。摘要未明确说明具体计算方法（如解析推导、数值模拟等），但提出了一种普适的相互作用形式，并基于此设计了Kitaev-Heisenberg模型的物理实现方案。

papers.title: Reality and Complexity of $F$-symbols in $2+1$d Topological Phases
papers.abstract: The $F$-symbols of an anyon theory encode the associativity of fusion and constitute some of the theory's most fundamental and, simultaneously, subtle data. Much of the subtlety lies in the gauge-dependence of the $F$-symbols. Despite their generic complexity, many braided anyon theories admit gauges in which all $F$-symbols are real, a phenomenon for which no general organising principle has been known. We identify a physical mechanism underlying this reality. For a unitary ribbon fusion category admitting an appropriate braided charge-conjugation symmetry, we show that the complex-conjugated $F$-symbols are related to the original ones by a gauge transformation. Finding a real gauge is thereby reduced to a condition on these transformations. When the charge-conjugation symmetry is suitably "flat,'' or equivalently when the associated "twisted'' Frobenius-Schur (or "generalized'' Kawanaka-Matsuyama) data respects a grading, these local transformations can be trivialised and a real gauge exists. This framework unifies a broad range of previously disparate examples, including families of Chern-Simons theories whose $F$-symbols are difficult to directly compute. Finally, we exhibit a unitary ribbon category that realizes a novel obstruction to the existence of a real gauge and therefore has inherently complex $F$-symbols.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要讨论的是拓扑相中任意子理论的数学结构（F-符号、规范变换、融合范畴），属于理论物理与数学物理交叉研究。；研究对象：2+1维拓扑相中的任意子理论，具体为幺正辫子融合范畴（unitary ribbon fusion category）的F-符号（即6j符号）的实性与复杂性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现任意子理论中F-符号可化为实数的物理机制：当理论具有适当的辫子电荷共轭对称性时，复共轭F-符号与原F-符号之间仅差一个规范变换；若该对称性满足“平坦”条件（等价于广义Frobenius-Schur数据尊重分级），则存在实规范。同时构造了一个具有本质复F-符号的幺正辫子范畴，展示了实现实规范的新型障碍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现任意子理论中F-符号可化为实数的物理机制：当理论具有适当的辫子电荷共轭对称性时，复共轭F-符号与原F-符号之间仅差一个规范变换；若该对称性满足“平坦”条件（等价于广义Frobenius-Schur数据尊重分级），则存在实规范。同时构造了一个具有本质复F-符号的幺正辫子范畴，展示了实现实规范的新型障碍。；创新点：首次为“许多辫子任意子理论存在实F-符号”这一长期缺乏组织原理的现象提供了统一的物理机制，将此前分散的各类例子（包括难以直接计算的Chern-Simons理论族）纳入同一框架，并首次展示了实规范存在性的新型障碍实例。
papers.method_zh: 采用拓扑量子场论与融合范畴的理论框架，具体包括：规范变换分析、电荷共轭对称性分析、Frobenius-Schur（Kawanaka-Matsuyama）广义数据的分级结构分析，以及Chern-Simons理论族作为具体例证。

papers.title: Raman Circular Dichroism Reveals Higher-Order Quantum Geometry of Magnons
papers.abstract: We develop a gauge-invariant theory of higher-order magnon quantum geometry probed by two-magnon Raman circular dichroism (RCD). The Raman operator decomposes into Berry connections, covariant derivatives, and products of Berry connections, giving rise to quantum geometric tensors beyond the quantum metric and Berry curvature. Applying this theory to a field-polarized Kitaev magnet, we show that higher-order geometric tensors govern the dichroic response. Our results establish RCD as a spectroscopic probe of generalized magnon quantum geometry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We develop a gauge-invariant theory”“Applying this theory”等表述，属于理论构建与计算分析，未涉及实验数据。；研究对象：磁振子（magnon）的高阶量子几何，具体体系为场极化Kitaev磁体（field-polarized Kitaev magnet），物理现象为双磁振子拉曼圆二色性（two-magnon Raman circular dichroism, RCD）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 高阶磁振子量子几何张量（超越量子度量和Berry曲率）主导了双磁振子拉曼圆二色性响应，从而将RCD确立为探测广义磁振子量子几何的光谱学手段。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：高阶磁振子量子几何张量（超越量子度量和Berry曲率）主导了双磁振子拉曼圆二色性响应，从而将RCD确立为探测广义磁振子量子几何的光谱学手段。；创新点：首次将拉曼圆二色性（RCD）与磁振子的高阶量子几何（而非仅量子度量和Berry曲率）建立直接联系，提出RCD可作为探测广义磁振子量子几何的谱学探针。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：规范不变的磁振子量子几何理论。具体手段：将拉曼算符分解为Berry联络、协变导数及Berry联络乘积，构造高阶量子几何张量；并将该理论应用于场极化Kitaev磁体模型进行计算分析。

papers.title: Large scale theoretical investigation of the phase diagram of twisted bilayer MoTe$_2$ at fractional fillings: agreements and contradictions with current experiments
papers.abstract: We present a comprehensive exact-diagonalization study of interaction-driven phases in twisted bilayer MoTe$_2$ across experimentally relevant twist angles ($2.13^\circ$--$4^\circ$) and hole fillings. Using continuum-model moiré bands, we compare the one-band-per-valley (1BPV) projection with a two-band-per-valley (2BPV) calculation that includes interaction-driven band mixing, and we benchmark both the widely used first-harmonic continuum model and a parameter-free DFT ``fitting-free'' model. At odd-denominator fillings, the 2BPV calculation reproduces the experimentally observed hierarchy of fractional Chern insulators (FCIs) around $θ\approx 3.7^\circ$, including robust incompressible states at $ν=-2/3$, $-3/5$, and $-4/7$ while correctly finding the absence of an FCI at $ν=-3/7$, and it favors a charge density wave ground state at $ν=-1/3$ over the FCI. At half filling $ν=-1/2$, the 1BPV calculation exhibits clear composite Fermi liquid (CFL) signatures, whereas the band mixing in 2BPV calculations destabilizes the CFL ground state. Finally, motivated by the Landau-level analogy at $θ\approx 2.13^\circ$, we test the proposed non-abelian Pfaffian state at $ν=-3/2$ in the fully-polarized spin sector but find no evidence for this state within the models and parameters studied. Our results establish a unified numerical benchmark for correlated and topological phases in twisted bilayer MoTe$_2$ and clarify where multi-band physics is essential for a quantitative comparison with experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：exact-diagonalization study、continuum-model、DFT。；研究对象：扭转双层MoTe₂（twisted bilayer MoTe₂）在分数填充下的相图，涵盖不同扭转角（2.13°–4°）和空穴填充数，重点研究分数量子反常霍尔（FCI）、复合费米液体（CFL）及电荷密度波等关联拓扑态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在奇分母填充下，两带/谷（2BPV）计算能复现实验观测的FCI层级（ν=-2/3、-3/5、-4/7）并正确预言ν=-3/7无FCI，且ν=-1/3处基态为电荷密度波而非FCI；在半填充ν=-1/2处，带混合会破坏CFL基态；在θ≈2.13°的ν=-3/2处未发现非阿贝尔Pfaffian态的证据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在奇分母填充下，两带/谷（2BPV）计算能复现实验观测的FCI层级（ν=-2/3、-3/5、-4/7）并正确预言ν=-3/7无FCI，且ν=-1/3处基态为电荷密度波而非FCI；在半填充ν=-1/2处，带混合会破坏CFL基态；在θ≈2.13°的ν=-3/2处未发现非阿贝尔Pfaffian态的证据。；创新点：首次在统一数值框架下系统比较不同模型（1BPV vs 2BPV、经验连续模型 vs DFT无拟合模型）对扭转双层MoTe₂分数填充相图的描述能力，明确指出多带物理在定量对比实验中的必要性，并填补了ν=-3/2处非阿贝尔态验证的空白。
papers.method_zh: 采用连续模型moiré能带进行精确对角化（exact diagonalization），对比单带/谷（1BPV）与两带/谷（2BPV）投影（后者包含相互作用驱动的带混合），并同时使用广泛采用的一次谐波连续模型和无参数DFT“无拟合”模型进行交叉验证。

papers.title: Imaging atomic scale stochasticity: noise in the nearly commensurate charge density wave of 1T-TaS$_2$ for leaky-integrator-and-fire neuromorphic emulator
papers.abstract: Low-dimensional materials are promising materials for emulating neuron-like firing were understanding of the atomic-scale origin of this behavior can benefit integration into neurormophic hardware. Using scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) as a highly local probe of correlations in the charge density wave (CDW), we study atomic-scale CDW noise in $1T\text{-}\mathrm{TaS}_2$ at room temperature. We statistically analyze the tunnel-junction noise and, to explain the temporally correlated current bursts, introduce a mesoscopic model in which the fractal structure and reorganization of CDW discommensurations are related. This noise mimics leaky-integrate-and-fire neuron dynamics. Our results show that atomic-scale current bursts in the tunnel junction can act as effective nonlinear elements in spiking neural emulators, enabling bioinspired processing through rich CDW dynamics at room temperature and supporting the miniaturization of spiking devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。依据：摘要明确使用扫描隧道显微镜（STM）作为实验手段，并进行了隧道结噪声的统计分析。；研究对象：1T-TaS₂ 中近公度电荷密度波（nearly commensurate CDW）的原子尺度噪声及其与漏电积分点火（leaky-integrate-and-fire）神经元动力学的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 室温下1T-TaS₂隧道结中的原子尺度电流突发（current bursts）具有时间相关性，其统计行为可模拟漏电积分点火神经元动力学，表明CDW的原子尺度噪声可作为脉冲神经模拟器中的有效非线性元件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：室温下1T-TaS₂隧道结中的原子尺度电流突发（current bursts）具有时间相关性，其统计行为可模拟漏电积分点火神经元动力学，表明CDW的原子尺度噪声可作为脉冲神经模拟器中的有效非线性元件。；创新点：首次将CDW的原子尺度噪声与漏电积分点火神经元动力学建立直接对应关系，提出利用隧道结中CDW的固有随机性实现室温仿生脉冲处理，为神经形态器件的微型化提供了新思路。
papers.method_zh: 扫描隧道显微镜（STM）作为局域探针测量CDW关联，对隧道结噪声进行统计分析，并引入介观模型将CDW失公度畴界（discommensurations）的分形结构与重组过程与时间相关的电流突发联系起来。

papers.title: Randomized Block Davidson Eigensolvers for Plane-Wave Density-Functional Theory
papers.abstract: Iterative diagonalization is the dominant cost of plane-wave density-functional theory (DFT), with search-space orthogonalization scaling particularly quickly with problem size and the number of target states. We present a randomized block Davidson-type eigensolver that replaces Euclidean orthogonalization with randomized Gram-Schmidt in a sketched inner product, requiring only a single pass over the basis while keeping its conditioning bounded independently of the input vectors. This modification changes only the Rayleigh-Ritz step, which becomes a definite generalized Hermitian eigenproblem. Ritz extraction remains exact, preserving true Ritz pairs and the interlacing property that makes each band energy an upper bound on the true one. The method is implemented in mixed precision for CPUs and GPUs from a single Julia code, interfaces matrix-free with DFTK, and is released in the open-source RandESC library. On sparse test problems with a fixed number of eigenpairs, the sketched solver overtakes its deterministic counterpart beyond matrix dimensions of about $2\times 10^4$ and is $25\%$ faster at $5\times 10^5$. In full self-consistent field DFT calculations, however, both Davidson variants outperform the locally optimal block preconditioned conjugate gradient (LOBPCG) reference only by $5$ to $11\%$ in total time, while the additional benefit of sketching is limited. As the number of requested states grows with system size, orthogonalization savings are offset by the generalized eigenproblem. Therefore, the regime in which sketching pays off is set by how the number of wanted states scales with the problem dimension, not by the eigensolver as such.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/算法方法文章。判断依据：摘要聚焦于迭代对角化算法、数值实现（Julia代码、CPU/GPU）及性能测试，属于计算方法开发。；研究对象：平面波密度泛函理论（DFT）中的电子结构计算，具体为求解广义厄米特征值问题的迭代对角化过程（搜索空间正交化与Rayleigh-Ritz步骤）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种随机化块Davidson特征值求解器，通过草图内积中的随机化Gram-Schmidt替代欧氏正交化，在保持Ritz对精确性的同时降低正交化成本；但实际自洽场DFT计算中，其相对确定性Davidson和LOBPCG的总时间优势有限（仅5–11%），且收益取决于目标态数量与问题维度的相对标度关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种随机化块Davidson特征值求解器，通过草图内积中的随机化Gram-Schmidt替代欧氏正交化，在保持Ritz对精确性的同时降低正交化成本；但实际自洽场DFT计算中，其相对确定性Davidson和LOBPCG的总时间优势有限（仅5–11%），且收益取决于目标态数量与问题维度的相对标度关系。；创新点：将随机化正交化（草图内积）引入块Davidson型特征值求解器，在保持Ritz提取精确性和能量上界性质（交错性质）的同时，将正交化成本与输入向量条件数解耦；并首次在平面波DFT全自洽计算中系统评估该方法的实际收益与适用标度区间。
papers.method_zh: 随机化线性代数方法：采用草图（sketched）内积进行随机化Gram-Schmidt正交化，仅需对基函数单次遍历；Rayleigh-Ritz步骤变为确定性的广义厄米特征值问题。实现上采用混合精度，基于Julia语言编写，支持CPU和GPU，并通过矩阵自由接口与DFT软件包DFTK集成，代码开源（RandESC库）。测试包括稀疏特征值问题及全自洽场DFT计算，并与确定性Davidson和LOBPCG对比。

papers.title: AlGaAs nanowires as a universal platform for GaAs, InGaAs, and InAs quantum dots
papers.abstract: Optical quantum dots (QDs) are central to photonic quantum technologies, with fabrication approaches tailored to different spectral ranges. A key challenge, however, is the realization of a unified platform$\unicode{x2014}$a single growth method combined with a host material offering a designable architecture$\unicode{x2014}$enabling wavelength tunability across the full emission range and co-integration of multiple quantum dots. Here, we introduce AlGaAs nanowires as a universal host for GaAs, InGaAs, and InAs QDs. Building on our previous demonstration of high-quality GaAs QDs, we realize InGaAs QDs with tunable emission by varying the growth duration from 2 to 5 s, achieving emission at 780 and 920 nm. We further showcase the platform's versatility for multi-quantum-dot devices by co-integrating two InGaAs QDs, as well as GaAs and InGaAs QDs within a single nanowire. Finally, we initiate a first step toward pure InAs QDs by growing a pristine InAs segment on AlGaAs nanowires, demonstrating material compatibility.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。依据：摘要描述了对纳米线中量子点的实际生长（如改变生长时长）与表征（发射波长测量），属于实验研究。；研究对象：AlGaAs纳米线作为通用衬底材料，在其上生长GaAs、InGaAs和InAs量子点（QDs），研究其发射波长可调性及多量子点共集成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: AlGaAs纳米线可作为通用平台，通过改变InGaAs量子点生长时长（2–5 s）实现发射波长在780 nm至920 nm之间的可调；并成功在同一纳米线中共集成两个InGaAs量子点以及GaAs与InGaAs量子点，且初步验证了纯InAs段与AlGaAs纳米线的材料兼容性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：AlGaAs纳米线可作为通用平台，通过改变InGaAs量子点生长时长（2–5 s）实现发射波长在780 nm至920 nm之间的可调；并成功在同一纳米线中共集成两个InGaAs量子点以及GaAs与InGaAs量子点，且初步验证了纯InAs段与AlGaAs纳米线的材料兼容性。；创新点：提出并验证了AlGaAs纳米线作为单一生长方法+单一宿主材料，覆盖GaAs、InGaAs、InAs三种量子点体系，实现全发射范围波长可调及多量子点共集成的“通用平台”概念。摘要未突出说明与已有其他平台（如液滴外延、选区外延）的系统性对比优势。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）生长AlGaAs纳米线及量子点结构；通过控制生长时长调节量子点组分与尺寸；利用光致发光（PL）光谱测量发射波长；通过共集成多个量子点验证器件级可行性。

papers.title: Tunable-Size Unruh-DeWitt Detector in a Multimode Cavity
papers.abstract: Quantum simulators based on Bose-Einstein condensates (BECs) provide a powerful platform to study relativistic quantum-field phenomena in the lab and in particular emulate relativistic analog particle detectors. However, such detectors typically couple to excitations beyond the acoustic phonon regime, so that the nonlinear Bogoliubov dispersion introduces corrections that cause the effective relativistic description to break down. We propose to overcome this limitation using an intrinsically momentum-selective Unruh-DeWitt detector model in which a tweezer-trapped atom couples to the condensate through a multimode optical cavity. Although the atom is effectively pointlike, the cavity-mediated interaction kernel causes it to sample density fluctuations over a controllable finite region of the BEC equivalent to a finite-size detector. The effective detector size is tunable via the cavity mode structure determining a controllable momentum cutoff that filters out nonphononic excitations. We analytically calculate the response of such a detector for uniform linear acceleration and uniform circular motion and show that this momentum selectivity can enhance the signal at experimentally accessible accelerations. Compatible with existing cavity-QED platforms our scheme thus provides a versatile setting for analog quantum-field measurements or relativistic quantum-information protocols.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose、analytically calculate、scheme。；研究对象：基于玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）的多模光腔量子模拟器中的Unruh-DeWitt探测器，具体研究该探测器在均匀线加速度和匀速圆周运动下的响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种具有内禀动量选择性的Unruh-DeWitt探测器模型，通过多模光腔中介的相互作用核使探测器等效为有限尺寸，其动量截断可滤除非声子激发，从而恢复有效的相对论描述，并在实验可及的加速度下增强探测信号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种具有内禀动量选择性的Unruh-DeWitt探测器模型，通过多模光腔中介的相互作用核使探测器等效为有限尺寸，其动量截断可滤除非声子激发，从而恢复有效的相对论描述，并在实验可及的加速度下增强探测信号。；创新点：通过腔模结构实现可调尺寸的等效探测器，利用动量选择性截断消除Bogoliubov非线性色散对相对论类比描述的破坏，从而在实验可及参数下增强Unruh效应信号。
papers.method_zh: 解析计算：对均匀线加速度和匀速圆周运动两种运动模式，解析推导探测器的响应函数；理论框架为腔QED与BEC量子模拟平台结合，利用多模腔模结构实现可控动量截断。

papers.title: Towards Stirling cooler operable single-photon sources based on low-noise GaAs quantum dots
papers.abstract: For photonic quantum technology applications, sources capable of emitting photons with indistinguishability close to unity are essential. Ideally, these sources should not require demanding cooling systems. Here, we present temperature-dependent two-photon-interference measurements on photons produced by the radiative decay of the negative trion in a low-noise GaAs quantum dot, which are in quantitative agreement with theoretical calculations accounting for carrier-phonon interactions and coupling to excited states. While at at the lowest explored temperatures the emission linewidth reaches values only 6(2) % above the Fourier limit and the indistinguishability I between subsequently emitted photons reaches 0.966(6), the latter drops to 0.05(4) at 55 K. We show that this loss can be explained with the coupling with energetically close excited trion states and suggest that the photon indistinguishability at elevated temperatures can be increased by employing Purcell enhancement of the emission rate or by increasing the energy separation of the excited states. Using cavity-enhanced emission, we experimentally verify the first route and demonstrate an improvement in photon indistinguishability from 0.314(25) to 0.80(3) at 32 K, which - to our knowledge - is the highest reported value at such temperature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（含理论对比与模拟）。判断依据：摘要明确描述“temperature-dependent two-photon-interference measurements”，并与“theoretical calculations”进行定量对比，同时包含实验验证（cavity-enhanced emission）。；研究对象：低噪声砷化镓（GaAs）量子点中负三子（negative trion）辐射衰变产生的单光子源，重点研究其光子不可区分度（indistinguishability）随温度的变化，以及载流子-声子相互作用和激发态耦合的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在最低温度下，GaAs量子点发射线宽仅比傅里叶极限高6(2)%，光子不可区分度达0.966(6)；但在55 K时不可区分度急剧下降至0.05(4)，该损失可由与能量相近的激发三子态耦合解释。通过腔增强（Purcell效应）在32 K下将不可区分度从0.314(25)提升至0.80(3)，为目前该温度下的最高报道值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在最低温度下，GaAs量子点发射线宽仅比傅里叶极限高6(2)%，光子不可区分度达0.966(6)；但在55 K时不可区分度急剧下降至0.05(4)，该损失可由与能量相近的激发三子态耦合解释。通过腔增强（Purcell效应）在32 K下将不可区分度从0.314(25)提升至0.80(3)，为目前该温度下的最高报道值。；创新点：首次在低噪声GaAs量子点体系中定量揭示高温下光子不可区分度损失的物理机制（激发态耦合），并实验证明通过Purcell增强可在较高温度（32 K）下显著恢复不可区分度，为无需斯特林制冷机（Stirling cooler）即可工作的单光子源提供了可行路径。
papers.method_zh: 温度依赖的双光子干涉（two-photon interference）测量；载流子-声子相互作用及激发态耦合的理论计算；采用腔增强（Purcell enhancement）手段提升发射率，实验验证该路线对不可区分度的改善。

papers.title: Nonlocal-nonlinear phonon polaritons
papers.abstract: When light is confined to deeply subwavelength volumes, optical responses can become nonlocal. Yet how nonlocality reshapes nonlinear light-matter interactions remains largely unexplored, particularly in dielectrics. Here, we theoretically uncover a new class of nonlinear optical processes arising from the interplay between optical-phonon propagation and ionic-bond anharmonicity in polar crystals. We show that, unlike conventional local nonlinearities, this mechanism enables second-order responses even in centrosymmetric materials. Moreover, these responses can be tuned by the confinement and resonantly enhanced near optical-phonon resonances. Using density functional perturbation theory, we quantify the resulting nonlocal second-order susceptibilities in representative polar crystals. Our results establish nonlocal-nonlinear optics as a new regime of light-matter interaction in dielectrics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“theoretically uncover”（理论揭示）、“Using density functional perturbation theory”（使用密度泛函微扰理论）以及“we quantify”（量化计算）。；研究对象：极性晶体（polar crystals）中由光学声子传播与离子键非谐性相互作用引发的非局域非线性光学过程，具体涉及非局域二阶非线性极化率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在极性晶体中，光学声子传播与离子键非谐性的耦合可产生一种新型非局域非线性光学响应，该机制即使在中心对称材料中也能产生二阶非线性效应，且该响应可通过光场限制进行调控，并在光学声子共振附近获得共振增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在极性晶体中，光学声子传播与离子键非谐性的耦合可产生一种新型非局域非线性光学响应，该机制即使在中心对称材料中也能产生二阶非线性效应，且该响应可通过光场限制进行调控，并在光学声子共振附近获得共振增强。；创新点：首次提出“非局域非线性光学”（nonlocal-nonlinear optics）作为介电材料中光-物质相互作用的新机制，突破了传统局域非线性光学对中心对称材料二阶响应禁戒的限制，并揭示了声子传播（非局域性）与晶格非谐性（非线性）之间的耦合效应。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与第一性原理计算：采用密度泛函微扰理论（DFPT）量化代表性极性晶体中的非局域二阶非线性极化率。

papers.title: Boundary Free Energies, Quenched Mixing, and Gibbs-State Selection in Disordered Ising Models
papers.abstract: We study boundary free energies and half-space responses in nearest-neighbor disordered Ising models. First, we prove the existence of fixed-depth tangential pressure and identify its derivative almost everywhere with the limiting boundary response. Second, under quenched exponential boundary-response mixing, we prove Gibbs-state selection independence and exponential convergence of finite-depth pressures. We further show that uniform one-spin mixing yields DLR uniqueness and Gaussian normal localization, and verify the required mixing conditions whenever $(2d-1)\mathbb E\tanh(β\vert{}J\vert{})<1$. Finally, we establish an all-face surface limit in the bounded Dobrushin regime and provide counterexamples that delimit general surface and stiffness claims.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“prove”“identify”“yield”“establish”等数学证明性动词，以及“Gibbs-state selection”“DLR uniqueness”等严格理论概念。；研究对象：无序伊辛模型（disordered Ising models），具体为最近邻相互作用、含随机耦合（J）的伊辛系统，关注其边界自由能、半空间响应、Gibbs态选择等统计力学问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无序伊辛模型中，证明了固定深度切向压力的存在性，并建立了边界响应与压力导数的几乎处处相等关系；在淬火指数边界响应混合条件下，证明了Gibbs态选择的独立性和有限深度压力的指数收敛性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无序伊辛模型中，证明了固定深度切向压力的存在性，并建立了边界响应与压力导数的几乎处处相等关系；在淬火指数边界响应混合条件下，证明了Gibbs态选择的独立性和有限深度压力的指数收敛性。；创新点：首次将边界自由能、淬火混合与Gibbs态选择三者系统联系起来，给出了均匀单自旋混合导致DLR唯一性和高斯正态局域化的充分条件，并明确了（2d−1）E tanh(β|J|)<1 这一可验证的混合条件；同时通过反例界定了表面自由能和刚度一般性结论的适用范围。
papers.method_zh: 严格数学证明方法，包括：边界自由能与半空间响应的分析、淬火混合条件下的压力收敛性分析、DLR（Dobrushin–Lanford–Ruelle）唯一性判据、Dobrushin有界区域下的表面极限分析，以及反例构造。

papers.title: Stable rotating vortex clusters in three-dimensional quantum droplets
papers.abstract: We predict a new type of stable three-dimensional (3D) vortex quantum droplets in binary Bose-Einstein condensate arranged into ring clusters that per-sistently rotate in the external potential. In contrast to clusters composed from localized quantum droplets, the states introduced here represent interacting vortex lines with identical topological charges nested in common 3D envelope and existing in much broader parameter range in comparison with local-ized quantum droplets. The intricate interplay between mean-field nonlinearity of Bose-Einstein condensate, quantum fluctuations described by Lee-Huang-Yang correction, Coriolis force arising due to rotation, and external potential leads to substantial variations of cluster shape upon increase of its rotation frequency. Rotating vortex clusters bifurcate from single-vortex quantum droplets and exist only above critical value of the rotation frequency that decreases with increase of chemical potential and depends on the number of vortex lines in the cluster. The radius of the cluster decreases with increase of rotation frequency and weakly varies with chemical potential, which determines mostly localization of the individual vortices in cluster and overall width of its envelope. Vortex droplet clusters are very robust objects existing in stable form in wide intervals of the number of particles for any number (odd or even) of vortex lines forming them. Our results may open the route to observation of stable arrays of vortex lines of different configurations per-forming regular collective motion in condensate.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要使用“predict”（预言）、“exist”（存在）等理论描述，未提及实验手段，属于理论预测与数值模拟类研究。；研究对象：二元玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）中的三维量子液滴，具体为在外部势阱中旋转的环形涡旋簇（由相同拓扑荷的涡旋线组成）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 预言了一种新型稳定的三维旋转涡旋量子液滴簇：与局域化量子液滴组成的簇不同，这些涡旋线共嵌于同一三维包络中，可在更宽的参数范围内稳定存在，且其形状随旋转频率增加发生显著变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：预言了一种新型稳定的三维旋转涡旋量子液滴簇：与局域化量子液滴组成的簇不同，这些涡旋线共嵌于同一三维包络中，可在更宽的参数范围内稳定存在，且其形状随旋转频率增加发生显著变化。；创新点：首次提出由相互作用涡旋线（而非局域化液滴）构成的旋转三维量子液滴簇，该类结构在更宽参数范围内稳定，且旋转频率存在临界值（随化学势增大而减小），簇半径随旋转频率增大而减小——这些性质与已知局域化液滴簇显著不同。摘要未突出说明与具体实验平台的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 基于平均场非线性（Gross-Pitaevskii类方程）与Lee-Huang-Yang量子涨落修正相结合的理论框架，并引入旋转产生的科里奥利力及外部势阱，通过数值求解研究涡旋簇的稳定性与分岔行为。

papers.title: Time-Dependent Tunneling in the Thin-Barrier Limit
papers.abstract: The usual WKB analysis for quantum tunneling applies when the tunneling action is large, as it is for tall, wide potential barriers. In contrast we analyze tunneling when the action is small, as it is for tunneling across a tall, thin barrier. We develop a perturbative analysis where the control parameter is the inverse of the area under the potential barrier and apply our technique to several examples in $1+1$ dimensions. In resonant situations for bound particles we find that the tunneling probability grows with time as $\propto t^2$, while in non-resonant situations it grows linearly with time. We evaluate not only the tunneling probability but also the time-dependent tunneling wavefunction for a particle that escapes to infinity, {\it i.e.} from a quasi-bound state to the continuum.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a perturbative analysis”（发展微扰分析），并涉及“WKB analysis”（WKB分析）等理论框架，未提及任何实验或数值计算细节。；研究对象：量子隧穿现象，具体为粒子穿过“高而薄”的势垒（tall, thin barrier）这一极限情形，以及粒子从准束缚态（quasi-bound state）隧穿到连续态（continuum）的时间依赖过程。体系为1+1维。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在薄势垒极限下（隧穿作用量小），束缚粒子的隧穿概率在共振情形下随时间呈 $\propto t^2$ 增长，而在非共振情形下随时间线性增长。此外，该工作还给出了逃逸至无穷远处的粒子的时间依赖隧穿波函数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在薄势垒极限下（隧穿作用量小），束缚粒子的隧穿概率在共振情形下随时间呈 $\propto t^2$ 增长，而在非共振情形下随时间线性增长。此外，该工作还给出了逃逸至无穷远处的粒子的时间依赖隧穿波函数。；创新点：传统WKB分析适用于高且宽的势垒（大作用量），而本工作专门针对“高而薄”的势垒（小作用量）发展了一套新的微扰理论，并给出了时间依赖的隧穿概率和波函数，特别是揭示了共振与非共振情形下不同的时间增长规律（$t^2$ vs $t$）。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为微扰分析，其控制参数是势垒下面积的倒数（即 $1/\int V(x)dx$ 的量级）。该方法是相对于传统WKB近似的补充，适用于隧穿作用量小的薄势垒情形。论文在1+1维下对多个具体例子进行了推导。

papers.title: Quantifying the Biophysical Properties of Red Blood Cells in Gaucher Disease
papers.abstract: Gaucher disease (GD), the most common lysosomal storage disorder, alters red blood cell (RBC) mechanics and circulation, contributing to vascular occlusions, bone infarcts, and splenomegaly. However, the individual roles of GD-RBC biophysical properties in these processes remain unclear. Here, we present a combined computational-experimental investigation to quantitatively characterize GD-RBC biophysical properties and determine how specific mechanical parameters drive abnormal RBC behavior. Informed by experimental data, we independently quantify key RBC properties, including shear modulus (mu), surface-to-volume ratio (S/V), and bending modulus (k_c). Based on these parameters, we construct three GD-RBC subtypes (GD-RBC1-3) to systematically isolate their individual contributions. At the single-cell level, optical tweezers simulations show up to ~27% reduction in axial diameter and ~42% reduction in transverse compression. Tank-treading dynamics exhibit non-monotonic behavior, with rotation frequencies increasing by up to ~70% or decreasing under elevated bending rigidity. In confined flow, traversal times through microchannel constrictions increase by more than a factor of two, while splenic slit passage times rise from ~250 ms (control) to >1200 ms for the severe GD-RBC subtype, approaching a functional no-passage threshold. At the population level, viscosity simulations demonstrate that these alterations collectively elevate blood viscosity, with small fractions (~4.0%) of highly rigid cells disproportionately increasing flow resistance. Overall, this study provides a quantitative and mechanistic framework that disentangles the contributions of key RBC parameters to abnormal behavior in GD, linking cellular-scale biophysics to hematologic dysfunction and microvascular occlusion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算-实验联合研究）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“combined computational-experimental investigation”，包含光学镊子模拟、受限流动模拟、黏度模拟等计算手段，以及实验数据支撑。；研究对象：戈谢病（Gaucher disease, GD）患者红细胞（RBC）的生物物理性质，具体包括剪切模量（μ）、表面积-体积比（S/V）和弯曲模量（k_c）等力学参数，以及这些参数异常对单细胞变形、坦克履带运动、微通道/脾窦穿行和血液黏度的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 戈谢病红细胞的力学参数异常（如剪切模量升高、弯曲刚度增大）导致单细胞变形能力显著下降（轴向直径减少达~27%，横向压缩减少达~42%），在受限流动中穿行时间成倍增加（脾窦穿行时间从~250 ms增至>1200 ms），且少量（~4.0%）高刚性细胞即可不成比例地升高血液黏度，提示其与微血管闭塞和血流动力学障碍直接相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：戈谢病红细胞的力学参数异常（如剪切模量升高、弯曲刚度增大）导致单细胞变形能力显著下降（轴向直径减少达~27%，横向压缩减少达~42%），在受限流动中穿行时间成倍增加（脾窦穿行时间从~250 ms增至>1200 ms），且少量（~4.0%）高刚性细胞即可不成比例地升高血液黏度，提示其与微血管闭塞和血流动力学障碍直接相关。；创新点：首次系统性地将戈谢病红细胞的多个关键力学参数（剪切模量、S/V比、弯曲模量）独立解耦，定量区分各自对异常红细胞行为的贡献，建立了从细胞尺度生物物理到血液功能障碍和微血管闭塞的定量机制框架。摘要未突出说明与以往研究的其他差异。
papers.method_zh: 结合实验数据与计算模拟：利用光学镊子模拟（optical tweezers simulations）量化单细胞轴向和横向变形；构建三种GD-RBC亚型（GD-RBC1-3）以独立分离各力学参数的贡献；进行坦克履带动力学模拟、微通道收缩段穿行模拟、脾窦穿行模拟，以及群体水平的血液黏度模拟。

papers.title: The Loss Floor of Denoising Score Matching: Fisher Geometry from Schrödinger Bridges
papers.abstract: Denoising score matching trains diffusion models by regressing onto a conditional score, although generation ultimately requires the marginal score. The two objectives share the same population minimizer, but the conditional target remains random at fixed noisy state and introduces an irreducible excess in the training loss. We isolate this excess and show that, for a general corruption kernel under mild regularity assumptions, it is exactly the trace of the Fisher--Rao metric of the conditional endpoint family, integrated along the diffusion trajectory. This gives an exact conditional-variance decomposition of the denoising objective and identifies the information geometry observed in diffusion latent spaces as an intrinsic component of the training loss. We derive the result from a Schr"odinger bridge variational principle, in which the ideal objective arises as excess path-space relative entropy. For corruption diffusions, the Fisher term is proportional to the rate at which the noisy state loses mutual information about the clean data, separating the loss floor into an information flow determined by the data and a weight determined by the corruption schedule and objective. In the Gaussian case, this yields a closed form for the floor, recovers reparametrization invariance of the continuous-time objective, and relates its high-SNR divergence to the information dimension of the data. Finally, we show that raw losses obtained with different noise ranges or weightings need not rank models consistently because they contain different additive floors, and contrast the second-order geometry seen by training with the third-order conditional statistics entering numerical sampling error.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“variational principle”“Fisher--Rao metric”“Schrödinger bridge”等理论推导与数学分析，未提及实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：扩散模型（diffusion models）中去噪分数匹配（denoising score matching）的训练损失下限（loss floor），以及其与Fisher几何、信息几何和Schrödinger桥的联系。属于机器学习与统计物理交叉的理论体系，非具体凝聚态材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 去噪分数匹配的训练损失中，存在一个由条件端点族Fisher–Rao度量迹给出的不可约超额项（loss floor），其沿扩散轨迹积分后精确等于条件方差分解；该损失下限与噪声状态对干净数据互信息的损失速率成正比，且在Gaussian情形下可解析表达，并与数据的信息维度相关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：去噪分数匹配的训练损失中，存在一个由条件端点族Fisher–Rao度量迹给出的不可约超额项（loss floor），其沿扩散轨迹积分后精确等于条件方差分解；该损失下限与噪声状态对干净数据互信息的损失速率成正比，且在Gaussian情形下可解析表达，并与数据的信息维度相关。；创新点：首次将去噪分数匹配的损失下限精确分解为Fisher–Rao度量的迹，并建立其与Schrödinger桥变分原理、互信息损失速率及信息维度之间的严格联系；同时指出不同噪声范围或加权下的原始损失因包含不同加性下限而不可直接用于模型排序。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：利用Schrödinger桥变分原理，将理想目标函数表示为路径空间相对熵的超额项；对一般腐蚀核（corruption kernel）在温和正则性假设下推导Fisher项；在Gaussian情形下给出闭式解，并分析重参数化不变性与高信噪比发散行为。

papers.title: Hartree--Fock coercivity for twisted bilayer graphene
papers.abstract: We study the minimisers of the Hartree--Fock functional for flat bands in the chiral model of twisted bilayer graphene introduced by Tarnopolsky, Kruchkov, and Vishwanath. Our model is a continuous version of the discrete model considered by Becker, Lin and Stubbs in previous works and the first result is a direct analogue of main theorems of those papers: at half filling of the flat band of multiplicity two, there are exactly two minimisers, obtained by occupying either one of the two sub-bands. (A more general version of this result, stressing its topological origins, was presented in Appendix A.8 of the Lecture Notes by Tao-Zworski.) The new contribution is the strict coercivity of the Hessian of the Hartree--Fock functional at the two minimisers. It is a consequence of the difference between the Chern numbers of the component bands and can be optimistically considered as a soft version of a ``spectral gap''.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要讨论Hartree–Fock泛函的极小值、Hessian矩阵的严格强制性等数学物理分析，属于理论推导。；研究对象：手性模型（chiral model）中的扭转双层石墨烯（twisted bilayer graphene, TBG）平带体系，具体为Tarnopolsky–Kruchkov–Vishwanath提出的连续模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二重简并平带的半填充条件下，Hartree–Fock泛函恰好存在两个极小值（分别占据两个子带之一）；并且在这两个极小值处，泛函的Hessian具有严格强制性（strict coercivity），该强制性源于子带Chern数之差，可视为一种“软”版本的“谱隙”。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二重简并平带的半填充条件下，Hartree–Fock泛函恰好存在两个极小值（分别占据两个子带之一）；并且在这两个极小值处，泛函的Hessian具有严格强制性（strict coercivity），该强制性源于子带Chern数之差，可视为一种“软”版本的“谱隙”。；创新点：首次证明了Hartree–Fock泛函在扭转双层石墨烯平带极小值处的Hessian严格强制性，并将其与子带Chern数差异建立直接联系，为“谱隙”提供了一种软性替代表述。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：对连续手性模型定义Hartree–Fock泛函，研究其极小值的存在性与唯一性，并通过计算Hessian的强制性来证明极小值的稳定性。该工作是对Becker–Lin–Stubbs离散模型结果的连续版本推广。

papers.title: Differential Learning for Robust Prediction of Thermal Stability with Application to Energetic Materials
papers.abstract: Predicting thermal stability during handling and storage is essential for the design of safe and reliable energetic materials. However, experimental measurements vary significantly across laboratories due to differences in protocols and analysis methods, making it difficult to train reliable predictive models. We address this challenge through differential learning. Rather than predicting absolute decomposition temperatures, we instead train message passing neural networks to predict relative differences between pairs of molecules. This approach reduces sensitivity to systematic experimental errors and achieves >85% accuracy in ranking compounds by thermal stability, outperforming conventional regression methods on the same heterogeneous dataset. To understand what drives these predictions, we compare neural network models with interpretable alternatives built from descriptors derived from ab initio calculations and cheminformatics software. This analysis identifies bond dissociation enthalpy as a key determinant of thermal stability rankings, providing further insight into the complex chemistry of thermal decomposition. The differential learning framework generalizes across model architectures, from graph neural networks to classical descriptor-based approaches. Our results demonstrate that learning relative properties rather than absolute values offers a practical solution for modeling noisy experimental data, with direct applications in materials design where thermal stability predictions inform safety protocols.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：训练神经网络模型、消息传递神经网络、从头计算（ab initio）描述符、图神经网络等关键词。；研究对象：含能材料（energetic materials）的热稳定性，具体为分子分解温度及其排序预测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过差分学习（differential learning）训练模型预测分子对之间的相对分解温度差异，而非绝对分解温度，可在异质实验数据集上实现超过85%的化合物热稳定性排序准确率，优于传统回归方法；并识别出键解离焓（bond dissociation enthalpy）是热稳定性排序的关键决定因素。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过差分学习（differential learning）训练模型预测分子对之间的相对分解温度差异，而非绝对分解温度，可在异质实验数据集上实现超过85%的化合物热稳定性排序准确率，优于传统回归方法；并识别出键解离焓（bond dissociation enthalpy）是热稳定性排序的关键决定因素。；创新点：提出差分学习框架，将绝对性质预测转化为相对差异预测，以降低跨实验室系统误差的影响；该框架可推广至不同模型架构（图神经网络与经典描述符方法），并揭示键解离焓作为关键物理描述符。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 消息传递神经网络（MPNN）用于差分学习；对比模型包括基于从头计算和化学信息学软件描述符的可解释模型（如经典描述符方法）；评估指标为排序准确率。

papers.title: General Construction of Time-Dependent Integrable Chiral Field Theories
papers.abstract: We develop a general procedure for constructing time-dependent integrable chiral field theories from autonomous unitary difference-form $S$-matrices satisfying the Yang-Baxter equation. Spectral parameters are transported along the free right- and left-moving characteristics, defining a map from physical spacetime to spectral space on which the two-body scattering data are evaluated. Requiring spatially homogeneous right-left scattering forces the characteristic map to be affine. The inverse Cayley transform then determines the local contact interaction, while evaluation along the affine spectral trajectory fixes its time dependence. Thus, the nonautonomous interaction is determined by the autonomous scattering data together with chiral kinematics and spatial homogeneity, rather than being introduced independently. The Yang--Baxter equation supplies the factorized many-body transport, and on a spatial circle periodicity leads to quantum Knizhnik--Zamolodchikov (qKZ) equations whose compatibility defines a flat discrete transport in spectral space. Pulling the corresponding spectral-space amplitudes back to physical coordinates gives the time-dependent many-body wavefunctions. Rational $SU(N)$, trigonometric $U_q(\widehat{\mathfrak{sl}}_2)$, and rational $O(N)$ scattering illustrate how the same mechanism generates distinct nonautonomous interactions. The resulting framework gives a geometric route from autonomous factorized scattering data to time-dependent integrable field theories.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：constructing、procedure、theoretical framework、Yang-Baxter equation。；研究对象：时依赖（非自治）可积手征场论，具体涉及基于不同自治S矩阵（有理型SU(N)、三角型U_q(𝔰𝔩₂)、有理型O(N)）构造的场论模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种普适构造方案：从满足Yang-Baxter方程的自治酉差分形式S矩阵出发，通过手征运动学与空间均匀性条件，唯一确定非自治（时依赖）局域接触相互作用，从而得到时依赖可积手征场论。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种普适构造方案：从满足Yang-Baxter方程的自治酉差分形式S矩阵出发，通过手征运动学与空间均匀性条件，唯一确定非自治（时依赖）局域接触相互作用，从而得到时依赖可积手征场论。；创新点：非自治相互作用并非独立引入，而是由自治散射数据、手征运动学和空间均匀性共同决定，从而建立了从自治因子化散射数据到时依赖可积场论的几何化构造路线。摘要未突出说明与以往构造方法的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论构造与解析推导。具体包括：利用特征线（右行/左行）将谱参数从物理时空映射到谱空间；要求空间均匀的左右散射迫使该映射为仿射变换；通过逆Cayley变换确定局域接触相互作用；在空间圆上利用周期性导出量子Knizhnik–Zamolodchikov（qKZ）方程，其相容性给出谱空间中的平坦离散输运；最后将谱空间振幅拉回物理坐标得到时依赖多体波函数。

papers.title: Classification of Non-Hermitian Flat Bands
papers.abstract: Exact flat bands provide a versatile setting for correlated and topological phenomena, yet their properties are controlled not only by their dispersion but also by the structure of their Bloch projectors. Here, we establish a projector-based classification of non-Hermitian flat bands. In contrast to Hermitian flat bands, non-Hermiticity introduces a biorthogonal projector whose left-right pairing permits a distinct norm-pole singularity. We identify four classes: analytic NH-A, continuous but nonanalytic NH-C, bounded but discontinuous NH-D, and pole-singular NH-E. We show that continuity of the biorthogonal projector preserves the locking of the right, left, and biorthogonal Chern numbers, $C_R=C_L=C_{\rm bi}$, thereby realizing non-Hermitian critical topological flat bands. Once continuity is lost, this locking can break down; in particular, a mismatch $C_R\neq C_L$ can occur in the NH-E class. Finally, we show that this Chern number mismatch ensures to produce an anomalous enhancement of resonant cross-orbital transfer. Our results establish biorthogonal projector regularity as the organizing principle linking compact localized states, topology, and driven response in non-Hermitian flat bands.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“establish a projector-based classification”“we show”“our results establish”等理论推导与分类框架表述，未涉及实验或数值计算细节。；研究对象：非厄米平带（non-Hermitian flat bands）系统，重点研究其布洛赫投影算符（Bloch projectors）的奇异性分类及其对拓扑性质（Chern数）和驱动响应（共振跨轨道转移）的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非厄米平带可根据双正交投影算符（biorthogonal projector）的正则性分为四类（NH-A、NH-C、NH-D、NH-E）；投影算符的连续性决定了左右及双正交Chern数是否锁定相等，而NH-E类中可出现C_R≠C_L的失配，并导致共振跨轨道转移的异常增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非厄米平带可根据双正交投影算符（biorthogonal projector）的正则性分为四类（NH-A、NH-C、NH-D、NH-E）；投影算符的连续性决定了左右及双正交Chern数是否锁定相等，而NH-E类中可出现C_R≠C_L的失配，并导致共振跨轨道转移的异常增强。；创新点：首次提出以双正交投影算符的正则性作为非厄米平带分类的组织原则，揭示了非厄米性导致的“范数极点奇异性”（norm-pole singularity）这一全新奇点类型，并建立了投影算符奇异性与Chern数失配、共振转移增强之间的直接联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于布洛赫投影算符的数学分类方法，引入非厄米双正交投影算符，分析其解析性、连续性、有界性与极点奇异性；结合Chern数锁定关系与驱动响应分析。

papers.title: Multi-hour stable trapping and threshold steady state of non-laser-coolable ions with ultracold atoms in a hybrid trap
papers.abstract: We report multi-hour stable trapping and steady state of non-laser-coolable Cs$^{+}$ ions in a linear Paul trap, achieved via resonant charge-exchange (RCE) cooling with a precisely centered ultracold Cs cloud. Without cold atoms, all ions are lost within 3 minutes. With centered cold atoms, RCE cooling establishes a stable population of ions for 6 hours with no measurable decay -- more than two orders of magnitude longer hold times compared to prior hybrid atom-ion systems. We observe a threshold behavior in the steady-state number of ions ($N_{s}$): initial ion loadings above $N_{s}$ ions converge downward to $N_{s}$ ions and remain constant thereafter; initial loadings below $N_{s}$ ions show no measurable decay. The dynamics is governed by a competition between ion-ion rf heating and ion-atom collisional cooling. The prolonged, simultaneous ion-atom trapping suggests an upper bound on the three-body recombination-induced Cs$_{2}^{+}$ formation rate constant: $k_{3} << 1.4 \times 10^{-25} cm^{6} s^{-1}$. This remarkable realization of long-lived steady state overcomes a critical limitation of prior hybrid atom-ion systems and enables extended studies of ultracold ion-neutral chemistry, rare inelastic collisions, and sympathetic cooling routes for complex molecular ions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：report、achieved via、measured、observed、demonstrates，涉及混合离子-原子阱实验。；研究对象：非激光可冷却的Cs⁺离子与超冷Cs原子在混合阱（线性Paul阱 + 磁光阱/光偶极阱）中的共存体系，具体研究离子-原子碰撞冷却、稳态离子数阈值行为及三体复合过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过共振电荷交换冷却，Cs⁺离子可在超冷Cs原子云中稳定囚禁6小时以上且无可测衰减，稳态离子数存在阈值行为；该体系将混合离子-原子系统的囚禁时间提高了两个数量级以上，并给出Cs₂⁺三体复合速率常数的上限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过共振电荷交换冷却，Cs⁺离子可在超冷Cs原子云中稳定囚禁6小时以上且无可测衰减，稳态离子数存在阈值行为；该体系将混合离子-原子系统的囚禁时间提高了两个数量级以上，并给出Cs₂⁺三体复合速率常数的上限。；创新点：首次在非激光可冷却离子体系中实现多小时的稳定离子-原子共存稳态，克服了此前混合离子-原子系统因射频加热导致离子快速丢失（约3分钟）的关键瓶颈；明确展示了离子数稳态的阈值动力学，并给出了极低的三体复合速率上限，为超冷离子-中性分子化学和复杂分子离子协同冷却研究开辟了长时间尺度实验平台。（摘要未突出说明其他创新点）
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用线性Paul阱囚禁Cs⁺离子，与精确对准的超冷Cs原子云（磁光阱或光偶极阱）耦合，利用共振电荷交换（RCE）实现离子冷却；通过改变初始离子装载数观测稳态离子数N_s的收敛/保持行为，测量离子存活时间与衰减率，并基于长时间共存数据约束三体复合速率常数k₃。

papers.title: On Split Forms of Fusion Categories
papers.abstract: We formulate split Galois descent for fusion categories through framed equivalences, reducing the existence of a split form to a group-theoretic splitting problem. The associated degree-two obstruction combines categorical coherence with stable descent of the simple objects, while fusion spaces impose index and parity restrictions. For quantum groups at roots of unity, we use the quasi-$R$-matrix to make the bar involution tensor-compatible and prove that the underlying fusion category $\mathcal C(\mathfrak g,k)$, associated with the simply connected root datum, has a split form over the maximal totally real subfield of the cyclotomic field generated by the quantum parameter. The same holds for all its cyclotomic Galois conjugates; in particular, every $\mathcal C(\mathfrak g,k)$ has a split real form. By contrast, no split real form exists for the standard braiding except on $\mathcal C(E_8,1)$ and $\mathcal C(D_{4m},1)$, $m \geq 1$. We further show that associative zesting can destroy real descent of $\mathcal C(\mathfrak g,k)$, while every braided zesting of $\mathcal C(\mathfrak g,k)$ still admits a split real form as an underlying fusion category. Applications to pointed and finite-group representation categories give criteria for real descent in terms of cohomology and Frobenius--Schur indicators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要涉及“Galois descent”“framed equivalences”“obstruction”“fusion categories”等纯数学物理理论概念，无实验或数值计算关键词。；研究对象：融合范畴（fusion categories）的“分裂形式”（split forms），特别是与量子群在单位根处相关的融合范畴 \(\mathcal C(\mathfrak g,k)\) 及其在最大全实子域上的实形式与伽罗瓦共轭形式。属于数学物理中拓扑序与张量范畴理论范畴。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了与单连通根数据相关的融合范畴 \(\mathcal C(\mathfrak g,k)\) 在量子参数生成的割圆域的最大全实子域上存在分裂形式，且其所有割圆伽罗瓦共轭亦然，因此每个 \(\mathcal C(\mathfrak g,k)\) 都有分裂实形式；但标准辫结结构仅在 \(\mathcal C(E_8,1)\) 和 \(\mathcal C(D_{4m},1)\) 上允许分裂实形式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了与单连通根数据相关的融合范畴 \(\mathcal C(\mathfrak g,k)\) 在量子参数生成的割圆域的最大全实子域上存在分裂形式，且其所有割圆伽罗瓦共轭亦然，因此每个 \(\mathcal C(\mathfrak g,k)\) 都有分裂实形式；但标准辫结结构仅在 \(\mathcal C(E_8,1)\) 和 \(\mathcal C(D_{4m},1)\) 上允许分裂实形式。；创新点：将分裂形式的存在性归结为群论分裂问题，并系统刻画了量子群融合范畴的实下降（real descent）条件；首次明确区分了底层融合范畴与带标准辫结结构时的分裂实形式存在性差异，并揭示了结合 zesting 与辫结 zesting 对实下降的不同影响。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：分裂伽罗瓦下降（split Galois descent）结合框架等价（framed equivalences）；利用拟 \(R\)-矩阵（quasi-\(R\)-matrix）使对合（bar involution）与张量结构相容；引入融合空间（fusion spaces）的指标与奇偶性限制；对点态与有限群表示范畴应用上同调与 Frobenius–Schur 指示子判据。

papers.title: Hamiltonian Learning at Scale
papers.abstract: Learning a quantum system's Hamiltonian is crucial for understanding and controlling its dynamics and has recently become a topic of widespread interest. To understand the learning protocol's error tolerances, i.e. its stability in the presence of inevitable errors, this work utilizes tensor network techniques to emulate Hamiltonian learning workflows at scale and with noise. Specifically, we employed a Hamiltonian learning technique based on approximate stationary states which are constructed using matrix product tools. We provide analytic bounds on the Hamiltonian learning estimation errors and perform numerical simulations that highlight learning error's stability under two families of errors. Using our workflow, we are able to scale up the protocol and learn mixed-field Ising model Hamiltonians of an $N=300$ site spin chain. By simulating the protocol at large scale, and empirically studying its practical limitations, our analysis of how errors affect the Hamiltonian learning process provides valuable lessons for future experiments. We conclude by discussing the avenues our work opens as well as future work that can support Hamiltonian learning experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“utilizes tensor network techniques”“perform numerical simulations”“provide analytic bounds”。；研究对象：量子系统的哈密顿量学习（Hamiltonian learning）协议，具体为混合场伊辛模型（mixed-field Ising model）的N=300自旋链。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用张量网络技术，哈密顿学习协议可以在含噪声条件下扩展到300个格点的大尺度系统，且学习误差对两类误差源具有稳定性；同时给出了学习估计误差的解析界。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用张量网络技术，哈密顿学习协议可以在含噪声条件下扩展到300个格点的大尺度系统，且学习误差对两类误差源具有稳定性；同时给出了学习估计误差的解析界。；创新点：首次将哈密顿学习协议扩展到N=300的大尺度自旋链，并在含噪声条件下系统研究其误差容忍度与实用性限制，为未来实验提供指导。（摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比差异。）
papers.method_zh: 基于矩阵乘积态（MPS）工具构造近似稳态（approximate stationary states），结合张量网络模拟哈密顿学习工作流；辅以解析误差界推导和数值模拟。

papers.title: Renormalization Group Flow Matching for Scalable Local Generative Modeling
papers.abstract: Despite their remarkable success in modeling complex data, generative models face a fundamental tradeoff. Global approaches can capture full structural coherence but suffer from high computational costs, while local models are efficient but often fail to reproduce long-range correlations and global coherence. The renormalization group (RG) bridges this gap by seamlessly connecting spatial structures across different length scales, retaining quasi-local descriptions at each step while preserving long-range correlations. We introduce renormalization group flow matching (RGFM), a generative framework that systematically structures data generation across different spatial scales. By using an exact RG flow as the probability path, RGFM progressively generates data from long- to short-wavelength structures. To reconcile scalability with global structure, we exploit two key properties of the RG: quasi-locality and scale separation. We rigorously show that the RGFM probability flow can be accurately approximated by local velocity fields acting over a spatial range $O(Λ^{-1}[\ln L+\ln(1/\varepsilon)])$ for RG wavenumber scale $Λ$, linear system size $L$, and prescribed error tolerance $\varepsilon$. This property enables local generative modeling with patches of size $O(\ln L)$ and a computational cost that scales nearly linearly with the system volume. We numerically demonstrate that local RGFM reproduces long-range correlations far beyond its receptive field in representative one-dimensional distributions, while conventional local flow matching exhibits substantial errors at long distances. On FFHQ images, RGFM yields far more coherent and higher-quality samples than local flow matching at 64x64 and 256x256. Our results establish RG-guided probability flows as a promising route toward scalable generative modeling that captures long-range structure using only local computation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及理论框架构建（RG flow作为概率路径）、严格证明（rigorously show）、数值演示（numerically demonstrate）以及图像生成实验（FFHQ images上的生成结果）。；研究对象：生成模型中的多尺度数据生成问题，具体以重正化群（RG）流作为概率路径，应用于一维分布和FFHQ图像（64x64和256x256）的生成建模。摘要未明确说明具体凝聚态材料体系，而是聚焦于RG理论在生成模型中的方法论应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: RGFM通过RG流将数据生成从长波长结构逐步推进到短波长结构，其概率流可由作用在空间范围O(Λ⁻¹[ln L + ln(1/ε)])内的局域速度场精确近似，从而实现了仅用局域计算即可捕获长程关联的规模化生成建模。数值上，局域RGFM在远超其感受野的距离上仍能复现长程关联，而传统局域流匹配在长距离上误差显著。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：RGFM通过RG流将数据生成从长波长结构逐步推进到短波长结构，其概率流可由作用在空间范围O(Λ⁻¹[ln L + ln(1/ε)])内的局域速度场精确近似，从而实现了仅用局域计算即可捕获长程关联的规模化生成建模。数值上，局域RGFM在远超其感受野的距离上仍能复现长程关联，而传统局域流匹配在长距离上误差显著。；创新点：首次将重正化群流作为生成模型的概率路径，利用RG的准局域性和尺度分离特性，从理论上证明了局域速度场近似RGFM概率流的可行性，并给出计算成本随系统体积近线性增长的保证。相比传统局域流匹配，RGFM在保持局域计算效率的同时显著改善了长程关联和全局一致性。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：精确RG流作为概率路径，利用RG的准局域性（quasi-locality）和尺度分离（scale separation）性质。严格证明：RGFM概率流可由局域速度场近似，误差可控。数值方法：一维代表性分布上的局域RGFM与传统局域流匹配对比；FFHQ图像上64x64和256x256分辨率的生成质量评估。

papers.title: TRACE: Transition-Aware Residual Control for Multi-Objective Materials Discovery
papers.abstract: Multi-objective materials discovery with LLM agents is often limited not only by how many candidates can be proposed, but by how effectively each costly property evaluation informs the next search step. Existing agents mainly store evaluated candidates and their scores, so they know which materials succeeded but not which executable edits caused useful property changes. This makes local refinement difficult when objectives compete and an edit that improves one property may damage another. We propose TRACE, a transition-aware residual control framework that treats evaluated edits as the basic unit of feedback. TRACE records each local refinement as a parent-edit-child transition with observed property deltas, aggregates transition evidence to estimate reusable edit effects, and ranks future edits by their predicted ability to reduce the current candidate's remaining constraint violations while avoiding damage to already satisfied objectives. In a controlled same-backbone comparison, TRACE improves over LLEMA, the state-of-the-art LLM-agent baseline, raising macro-average hit rate from 18.13\% to 25.96\%.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/算法文章。判断依据：摘要聚焦于LLM智能体框架设计、反馈机制与命中率提升，属于机器学习驱动的材料发现方法研究，而非实验或传统物理理论。；研究对象：多目标材料发现（multi-objective materials discovery），即需同时优化多个相互冲突的材料性能指标的候选材料筛选问题。摘要未明确指定具体材料体系或物性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出TRACE框架，将“局部编辑（parent-edit-child transition）”作为反馈基本单元，通过聚合编辑前后性质变化（property deltas）来估计可复用编辑效果，从而在保持已满足目标的同时减少剩余约束违反。在相同主干模型对比中，TRACE将宏平均命中率从18.13%提升至25.96%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出TRACE框架，将“局部编辑（parent-edit-child transition）”作为反馈基本单元，通过聚合编辑前后性质变化（property deltas）来估计可复用编辑效果，从而在保持已满足目标的同时减少剩余约束违反。在相同主干模型对比中，TRACE将宏平均命中率从18.13%提升至25.96%。；创新点：将反馈单元从“已评估的候选材料及其分数”细化为“可执行的编辑及其性质变化”，使智能体不仅知道哪些材料成功，还知道哪些具体修改导致了有用的性质变化，从而在多目标竞争场景下实现更有效的局部精修。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 基于LLM智能体的材料发现框架，具体包括：①将每次局部优化记录为“父结构-编辑-子结构”三元组并附带性质变化量；②跨候选材料聚合编辑证据以估计可复用效果；③按预测的约束违反减少能力对候选编辑排序。对比基线为LLEMA（state-of-the-art LLM-agent baseline）。

papers.title: Ultracold Neutron Sources: An Essentially Enhanced Optimal Operation Temperature for Ortho-Deuterium-Based Superthermal Converters
papers.abstract: There is a longstanding dogma in the physics of ultracold neutrons (UCN): The optimal temperature of ortho-deuterium based UCN-sources must not exceed $5\,\mathrm{K}$. This value has been established by the pioneering work of Golub et al. decades ago, utilizing previously established cross sections for solid ortho-deuterium. But recently, an improved calculation of the crucial 1-phonon up-scattering cross section - using the so-called corrected Incoherent Approximation - leads to a new upper limit for the optimal operation temperature of ortho-deuterium based UCN sources. After a discussion of the relevant cross sections of the \(\mathrm{D}_2\)-molecule we conclude that the optimal temperature lies between $10\,\mathrm{K}$ and $12\,\mathrm{K}$, a factor 2 higher than estimated earlier. This offers significantly relaxed cryogenic conditions for UCN experiments with solid ortho-deuterium and especially for the operation of ortho-deuterium based ultracold neutron sources.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：improved calculation、cross section、Incoherent Approximation。；研究对象：固态正氘（ortho-deuterium，即固态D₂分子晶体）作为超热转换型超冷中子（UCN）源材料时的最佳工作温度。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于修正的非相干近似（corrected Incoherent Approximation）重新计算关键的单声子升散射截面后，正氘基UCN源的最佳工作温度上限从长期公认的5 K提升至10–12 K，比此前估计高约2倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于修正的非相干近似（corrected Incoherent Approximation）重新计算关键的单声子升散射截面后，正氘基UCN源的最佳工作温度上限从长期公认的5 K提升至10–12 K，比此前估计高约2倍。；创新点：推翻了数十年来“正氘UCN源工作温度不得超过5 K”的既有结论，通过改进单声子升散射截面的计算方法，将最佳工作温度上限提高至10–12 K，从而大幅放宽了低温工程条件。
papers.method_zh: 理论计算：采用修正的非相干近似计算固态正氘的1-声子升散射截面，并结合D₂分子的相关散射截面讨论，重新评估UCN源的超热转换效率随温度的变化。

papers.title: Compact nondestructive generator for microsecond-class ultrafast pulsed magnetic fields
papers.abstract: The sweep rate of pulsed magnetic fields is a key factor in exploring of nonequilibrium phenomena in matter. However, the nondestructive generation of ultrafast pulsed magnetic fields is challenging because of the large time constants associated with the large inductance and capacitance of conventional pulsed magnetic field generators, as well as the residual inductance of the power devices and the system itself. We have developed a new compact pulsed magnetic field generator using commercially available state-of-the-art ultrafast power devices, enabling the generation of ultrafast pulsed magnetic fields up to approximately 1 T with a pulse duration of 3.8 $μ$s. We present the performance of the newly developed system and compare the experimentally obtained magnetic field waveforms with the results of a simple circuit simulation. In addition, we demonstrate magnetization measurements on cobalt powder and Faraday rotation measurements on CdS single crystal using the developed system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了新系统的开发、性能展示以及实验测量（磁化测量、法拉第旋转测量）。；研究对象：脉冲磁场技术及其在物质非平衡现象研究中的应用；具体测试材料为钴粉（Co powder）和CdS单晶。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用商用超快功率器件构建了紧凑型非破坏性脉冲磁场发生器，可产生峰值约1 T、脉宽3.8 μs的超快脉冲磁场，并成功用于钴粉磁化测量和CdS单晶法拉第旋转测量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用商用超快功率器件构建了紧凑型非破坏性脉冲磁场发生器，可产生峰值约1 T、脉宽3.8 μs的超快脉冲磁场，并成功用于钴粉磁化测量和CdS单晶法拉第旋转测量。；创新点：通过采用商用超快功率器件，显著降低了传统脉冲磁场发生器因大电感和电容带来的时间常数问题，实现了微秒级（3.8 μs）非破坏性超快脉冲磁场的紧凑化生成。摘要未突出说明与传统方案相比的具体性能优势量化指标。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：基于商用超快功率器件的紧凑型脉冲磁场发生器；磁场波形与简单电路仿真结果对比；磁化测量（钴粉）；法拉第旋转测量（CdS单晶）。

papers.title: Relation between crystal melting temperature ${T}_{m}$ and glass transition temperature ${T}_{g}$ determined by the response of the caged molecule dynamics
papers.abstract: An empirical finding is that the ratio of glass transition temperature Tg to the crystal melting temperature Tm is near 23 for many glass-forming materials. The key to understand the origin of the 23 rule is the availability of a theoretical method to determine Tm and its relation to Tg. In this pap…
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要强调“theoretical method to determine Tm and its relation to Tg”，核心是提出理论方法。；研究对象：玻璃形成材料的玻璃化转变温度 Tg 与晶体熔化温度 Tm 之间的关系，具体关注“Tg/Tm ≈ 2/3”经验规律（即2/3规则）的物理起源，涉及笼形分子动力学响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未完整给出最终结论，但明确指出关键在于建立一种能同时确定 Tm 并揭示其与 Tg 关联的理论方法，该方法基于笼形分子动力学的响应特性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未完整给出最终结论，但明确指出关键在于建立一种能同时确定 Tm 并揭示其与 Tg 关联的理论方法，该方法基于笼形分子动力学的响应特性。；创新点：首次从笼形分子动力学响应的角度出发，提出一种统一确定 Tm 并解释 Tg/Tm ≈ 2/3 规则的理论途径。摘要未突出说明更多细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导，具体框架为基于“caged molecule dynamics”（笼形分子动力学）的响应分析，用以确定 Tm 并建立其与 Tg 的定量关系。摘要未提及具体计算或实验手段。

papers.title: Phonon-induced hypersensitive transitions in lanthanide double perovskites

Buyanova, Weimin M. Chen, Sergei I. Simak, Igor A. Abrikosov, Yuttapoom Puttisong, and Feng Gao Lanthanide ions exhibit characteristic emission originating from intra-4f transitions. Among them, hypersensitive transitions (HSTs) are distinguished by their pronounced spectral tunability. Conventional HST emitters typically rely on dilute doping and host-to-4f charge transfer, which are often li…
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合部分理论计算）。判断依据：摘要中提及多种实验手段（如光谱测量、同步辐射等）以及理论计算（如Simak、Abrikosov等作者通常涉及第一性原理计算），但以实验为主。；研究对象：镧系离子双钙钛矿材料中的声子诱导超灵敏跃迁（hypersensitive transitions, HSTs）。具体涉及镧系离子的4f-4f跃迁发光及其光谱可调性。

papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未完整给出最终结论（摘要被截断），但可确认该工作研究了镧系双钙钛矿中由声子参与的HSTs，并指出传统HST发射体依赖稀掺杂和基质到4f的电荷转移，而本工作可能提出了一种新的机制或材料体系来增强或调控HSTs。；创新点：摘要未完整展示，但可推断其创新点在于：在镧系双钙钛矿体系中利用声子效应（而非传统稀掺杂或电荷转移）来实现或增强超灵敏跃迁，这可能为HST发射体提供新的设计思路。具体细节因摘要截断而无法确认。
papers.method_zh: 摘要中提及的实验手段包括：光谱测量（如发光光谱）、同步辐射光源（Kivimäki, Chernenko等作者通常涉及同步辐射X射线技术）、以及理论计算（Simak, Abrikosov为第一性原理计算专家）。具体方法如DFT或GW等未在摘要中明确列出。

papers.title: Strain-controlled sign reversal of the anomalous Hall effect in $\mathrm{Ru}/{[\mathrm{Co}/\mathrm{Ni}]}_{N}$ multilayers
papers.abstract: The anomalous Hall effect (AHE) is a hallmark transport phenomenon in ferromagnets arising from relativistic spin-orbit interaction. Here, we report an unexpected sign reversal of the AHE in Ru/[Co/Ni]N multilayers controlled by the stacking sequence of the Ru layer. When Ru is placed beneath, rathe…
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we report”（我们报道）等表述，描述的是对实际多层膜体系中反常霍尔效应的观测结果。；研究对象：Ru/[Co/Ni]N 多层膜体系，具体研究其中反常霍尔效应（AHE）的符号随 Ru 层堆叠顺序（置于多层膜下方或上方）的变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Ru/[Co/Ni]N 多层膜中，反常霍尔效应的符号可以通过改变 Ru 层的堆叠顺序（置于下方 vs. 上方）实现意外反转。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Ru/[Co/Ni]N 多层膜中，反常霍尔效应的符号可以通过改变 Ru 层的堆叠顺序（置于下方 vs. 上方）实现意外反转。；创新点：首次报道了在 Ru/[Co/Ni]N 多层膜中，仅通过改变 Ru 层的堆叠位置（而非磁场或组分）即可实现反常霍尔效应符号的反转，这一现象超出了常规铁磁体中 AHE 由自旋-轨道耦合决定的预期行为。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段（如薄膜生长方法、输运测量装置等），仅提及对反常霍尔效应的测量以及通过堆叠顺序进行调控。

papers.abstract: Author(s): Zahra Makhdoumi Kakhaki, Anton O. Pokusinskyi, Francesco Avitabile, Abhishek Kumar, Francesco Colangelo, Carla Cirillo, Carmine Attanasio, and Oleksandr V.
